Diff output format options
    -p, --patch           generate patch

    -u                    generate patch
    -U, --unified[=<n>]   generate diffs with <n> lines context
    -W, --function-context

    --cumulative          synonym for --dirstat=cumulative

    --name-status         show only names and status of changed files
    --stat[=<width>[,<name-width>[,<count>]]]

    --stat-name-width <width>

    --stat-graph-width <width>

    --stat-count <count>  generate diffstat with limited lines
    --compact-summary     generate compact summary in diffstat
    --binary              output a binary diff that can be applied

    --color[=<when>]      show colored diff
    --ws-error-highlight <kind>

    -z                    do not munge pathnames and use NULs as output field terminators in --raw or --numstat
    --abbrev[=<n>]        use <n> digits to display object names
    --src-prefix <prefix>

    --dst-prefix <prefix>

    --line-prefix <prefix>

    --no-prefix           do not show any source or destination prefix
    --inter-hunk-context <n>

    --output-indicator-new <char>

    --output-indicator-old <char>

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# =============================================================================
3	# evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh — sandbox materialisation and arm toggles
4	#
5	# cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.6 (SDD D-4.5, DEC-0421, DEC-0423, DEC-0396).
6	# Extracted from execute-agent.sh (cycle-129 step 2 and the toggle functions)
7	# WITHOUT behaviour change for the cycle-129 single-skill path, and shared with
8	# pipeline-run.sh. Source it; it defines functions only and sets no shell
9	# options (the caller runs under `set -euo pipefail`).
10	#
11	# Contract (every function returns 0 on success, 2 when refused / when a step
12	# cannot take effect; refusals name the reason on one stderr line):
13	#
14	#   mount_prompt_surface <ws> <prompt_tree> <skill|->
15	#       skill given: <ws>/.claude/skills/<skill>/ (whole dir), .claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md,
16	#       .claude/rules/, CLAUDE.md = "@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"; the prompt tree's
17	#       .loa.config.yaml only in arm mode (LOA_EVAL_ARM set), as cycle-129 did.
18	#       skill "-": the whole .claude/ tree is copied (files, never a symlink to the
19	#       tree), CLAUDE.md as above, and .loa.config.yaml always (the pipeline
20	#       executor needs every skill, hook and script). Evidence: mount=skill:<s>|tree.
21	#   resolve_arm_toggles <arm> <suite_file>
22	#       prints the arm's toggles as compact JSON on stdout. Arms are read from
23	#       `.arms[]` (ablation-2.0) and `.ab.arms[]` (recall suites). An arm with
24	#       toggles {} (a1_full, baseline) prints {}; `baseline` undeclared prints {}.
25	#       Exit 2: undeclared arm (an unreadable suite file declares none), `absent: true` arm.
26	#   apply_arm_toggles <ws> <toggles_json> <arm>
27	#       applies every toggle to the SANDBOX COPY and verifies it afterwards; exit 2
28	#       when one cannot take effect or is unknown. Toggles and values:
29	#         companion_voice: false  flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false
30	#         karpathy_block: false   '## Karpathy Principles' out of CLAUDE.loa.md (+ constraints.json rows)
31	#         rule_files: false       stash-safety.md, skill-invariants.md out of .claude/rules/
32	#         audit_delta_instruction: false  the delta paragraph out of auditing-security/SKILL.md
33	#         loa_mount: false        verifies no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml in <ws>
34	#                                 (the caller skips mount_prompt_surface); evidence loa_mount=none
35	#         effort: low|medium|high|xhigh|max
36	#                                 every `effort:` line out of the frontmatter of every
37	#                                 <ws>/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; every `default_effort` key in
38	#                                 <ws>/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml set to the value and its
39	#                                 .checksum (bare sha256 hex) refreshed when present.
40	#                                 The caller passes `--effort <v>` on argv.
41	#         gates: false            flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false;
42	#                                 LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false exported in the CALLING shell
43	#                                 and written to $ARM_ENV_FILE (KEY=VALUE lines) when that is set
44	#         flatline: false         flatline_protocol.enabled=false
45	#         sprint_plan: false, context_resets: false
46	#                                 phase-set edits owned by the pipeline executor; recorded as
47	#                                 evidence here (the single-skill executor refuses them itself)
48	#   regen_sandbox_manifest <ws>
49	#       writes <ws>/.claude/checksums.json {generated, algorithm: sha256, files} over
50	#       every regular file under <ws>/.claude except overrides/ and the manifest
51	#       itself (LC_ALL=C order, sha256). tools/gen-checksums.sh (in the
52	#       prompt tree, $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE) is used instead when it exists AND <ws> is a
53	#       git repository tracking .claude files (it lists `git ls-files`). No .claude/
54	#       (loa_mount: false) → manifest_sha256=none, exit 0. Prints manifest_sha256=<hex>.
55	#   check_fixture_path_rule <fixture_dir>
56	#       exit 2 (offending paths on stderr) when the fixture's top level holds
57	#       .claude, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires or .run — the mount owns
58	#       those paths (DEC-0396); exit 0 otherwise.
59	#   write_sandbox_grimoire <ws> <task_yaml> <arm> <sprint_label>
60	#       grimoires/loa/ledger.json (one active cycle, <sprint_label> planned, global 1;
61	#       the ledger-lib.sh schema), NOTES.md (header only), context/task-brief.md (the
62	#       task's agent-facing `criterion` + the TASK.md next to task.yaml),
63	#       a2a/<sprint_label>/ (empty); review-catch tasks also get a one-sprint
64	#       grimoires/loa/sprint.md naming pr/head.diff and a2a/<sprint_label>/reviewer.md
65	#       carrying pr/PR.md (sandbox copy, else the corpus fixture's). An arm whose
66	#       toggles carry sprint_plan: false (resolved from $LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE, default
67	#       evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml) gets NO sprint.md. Build tasks leave sprint.md
68	#       to the PLAN phase. Nothing written names the arm.
69	#   init_sandbox_beads <ws> <task_title>
70	#       `br init --prefix bd --no-daemon` in <ws> plus one task bead with the title
71	#       when br ($LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN, default br) is on PATH → beads=br; else the opt-out
72	#       marker through <ws>/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh --opt-out →
73	#       beads=opt-out; neither → beads=none (exit 0).
74	#
75	# Hashing is Python hashlib (_sm_sha256), never .claude/ code: see _sm_sha256.
76	# Callers source this file by a literal relative path (no variable expansion
77	# on the source line), as eval.yml's trust-boundary scan requires.
78	#
79	# Evidence: every function reports `key=value` lines (one line, no newline in
80	# the value). When ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE is set they are appended to that file;
81	# else they go to the descriptor in SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD (default 1).
82	# resolve_arm_toggles prints JSON on stdout and no evidence.
83	#
84	# Tested by evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats (directly and through execute-agent.sh)
85	# and evals/tests/execute-agent.bats.
86	# =============================================================================
87	
88	[[ "${_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED:-}" == "true" ]] && return 0
89	_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED=true
90	
91	_SM_LIB_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
92	_SM_REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$_SM_LIB_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"
93	
94	_sm_err() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; }
95	
96	# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
97	# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
98	# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
99	# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh
100	# hashes the corpus the same way.
101	_sm_sha256() {
102	  python3 -I -c '
103	import hashlib, sys
104	for p in sys.argv[1:]:
105	    h = hashlib.sha256()
106	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
107	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
108	            h.update(b)
109	    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
110	}
111	
112	# _sm_evidence <key> <value> — one key=value line to the evidence sink.
113	_sm_evidence() {
114	  local line="$1=${2//$'\n'/ }"
115	  if [[ -n "${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
116	    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
117	  else
118	    local fd="${SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD:-1}"
119	    [[ "$fd" =~ ^[0-9]$ ]] || fd=1
120	    printf '%s\n' "$line" >&"$fd"
121	  fi
122	}
123	
124	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
125	mount_prompt_surface() {
126	  local ws="$1" tree="$2" skill="${3:-}"
127	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
128	  [[ -d "$tree/.claude" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: prompt tree has no .claude/: $tree"; return 2; }
129	  if [[ "$skill" == "-" ]]; then
130	    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude"
131	    cp -a "$tree/.claude/." "$ws/.claude/" || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: copying .claude/ failed"; return 2; }
132	    printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
133	    if [[ -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"; fi
134	    _sm_evidence mount "tree"
135	    return 0
136	  fi
137	  case "$skill" in */*|.*|'') _sm_err "invalid skill name '$skill'"; return 2 ;; esac
138	  local skill_src="$tree/.claude/skills/$skill"
139	  [[ -f "$skill_src/SKILL.md" ]] || { _sm_err "prompt tree $tree has no .claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md"; return 2; }
140	  mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/skills" "$ws/.claude/loa"
141	  # Whole skill dir (resources included) so guarded reads inside the skill resolve.
142	  local skill_dst="$ws/.claude/skills/$skill"
143	  mkdir -p "$skill_dst"
144	  cp -a "$skill_src/." "$skill_dst/"
145	  if [[ -f "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" ]]; then
146	    cp "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" "$ws/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
147	  fi
148	  if [[ -d "$tree/.claude/rules" ]]; then
149	    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/rules"
150	    cp -a "$tree/.claude/rules/." "$ws/.claude/rules/"
151	  fi
152	  printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
153	  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM+x}" && -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then
154	    cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"
155	  fi
156	  _sm_evidence mount "skill:$skill"
157	  return 0
158	}
159	
160	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
161	resolve_arm_toggles() {
162	  local arm="$1" suite_file="${2:-}"
163	  [[ "$arm" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "invalid arm id '$arm'"; return 2; }
164	  local found=0 entry=""
165	  if [[ -n "$suite_file" && -f "$suite_file" ]]; then
166	    # an unreadable suite file reads as "not declared" (cycle-129 behaviour: baseline still resolves to {})
167	    entry="$(ARM="$arm" yq -o=json -I=0 '[((.arms // [])[]), ((.ab.arms // [])[])] | map(select(.id == strenv(ARM))) | .[0] // null' "$suite_file" 2>/dev/null)" \
168	      || entry=""
169	    [[ -n "$entry" && "$entry" != "null" ]] && found=1
170	  fi
171	  if [[ "$found" -eq 0 ]]; then
172	    [[ "$arm" == "baseline" ]] && { printf '{}'; return 0; }
173	    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is not declared in ${suite_file:-any suite} (arms[] / ab.arms[])"
174	    return 2
175	  fi
176	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$entry")" == "true" ]]; then
177	    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is declared absent in $suite_file (never run): $(jq -r '.evidence // "no evidence"' <<<"$entry")"
178	    return 2
179	  fi
180	  local t
181	  t="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$entry")"
182	  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$t" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not an object in $suite_file"; return 2; }
183	  printf '%s' "$t"
184	}
185	
186	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
187	# Remove the markdown section that starts at the exact heading line $2 (up to
188	# the next level-2 heading) from file $1. Prints the number of lines removed.
189	_sm_drop_md_section() {
190	  local f="$1" heading="$2" tmpdir="$3" tmp
191	  tmp="$(mktemp "$tmpdir/.arm.XXXXXX")"
192	  awk -v h="$heading" '
193	    $0 == h { skip = 1; n++; next }
194	    skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
195	    skip { n++; next }
196	    { print }
197	    END { print n + 0 > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
198	  mv "$tmp" "$f"
199	  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
200	}

202	# Remove the first blank-line-delimited paragraph of $1 that contains one of
203	# the needles (tried in order, case-insensitive). Writes the removed text to
204	# $2; exit 1 when no needle matches.
205	_sm_drop_paragraph() {
206	  python3 -I - "$1" "$2" "look for what the review did not" "Confirm the review's demotions independently" <<'PY'
207	import re, sys
208	path, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
209	text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
210	paras = re.split(r"(\n[ \t]*\n)", text)
211	for needle in sys.argv[3:]:
212	    for i in range(0, len(paras), 2):
213	        if needle.lower() in paras[i].lower():
214	            removed = paras[i]
215	            # drop the paragraph and the separator that follows it
216	            del paras[i:i + 2]
217	            open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("".join(paras))
218	            open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(removed + "\n")
219	            sys.exit(0)
220	sys.exit(1)
221	PY
222	}

224	# Strip every `effort:` line from the YAML frontmatter of file $1 (frontmatter
225	# = line 1 `---` up to the next `---`). Prints 1 when a line was removed, else 0.
226	_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort() {
227	  local f="$1" tmp
228	  tmp="$(mktemp "$f.XXXXXX")"
229	  awk '
230	    NR == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 1; print; next }
231	    fm == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 2; print; next }
232	    fm == 1 && /^effort:/ { n++; next }
233	    { print }
234	    END { print (n > 0 ? 1 : 0) > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
235	  cat "$tmp" > "$f"; rm -f "$tmp"
236	  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
237	}

239	# 0 when file $1's frontmatter still carries an `effort:` line.
240	_sm_frontmatter_has_effort() {
241	  awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" { exit 1 } NR > 1 && $0 == "---" { exit 1 } NR > 1 && /^effort:/ { found = 1; exit 0 } END { exit (found ? 0 : 1) }' "$1"
242	}

255	apply_arm_toggles() {
256	  local ws="$1" toggles="${2:-}" arm="${3:-}"
257	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "apply_arm_toggles: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
258	  [[ -n "$toggles" ]] || toggles='{}'
259	  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$toggles" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not a JSON object"; return 2; }
260	  local eval_dir="$ws/.eval"
261	  mkdir -p "$eval_dir"
262	  local key val
263	  while IFS=$'\t' read -r key val; do
264	    [[ -n "$key" ]] || continue
265	    if [[ "$key" == "effort" ]]; then
266	      case "$val" in low|medium|high|xhigh|max) ;; *) _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggle effort=$val (want low|medium|high|xhigh|max)"; return 2 ;; esac
267	    elif [[ "$val" != "false" ]]; then
268	      _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggle $key=$val (only false is defined)"; return 2
269	    fi
270	    case "$key" in
271	      companion_voice)
272	        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice .flatline_protocol.security_audit.companion_voice \
273	          || { _sm_err "companion_voice toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
274	        _sm_evidence companion_voice "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false"
275	        ;;
276	      karpathy_block)
277	        local k="$ws/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" n
278	        [[ -f "$k" ]] || { _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: no sandbox CLAUDE.loa.md"; return 2; }
279	        n="$(_sm_drop_md_section "$k" '## Karpathy Principles' "$eval_dir")"
280	        if [[ "${n:-0}" -eq 0 ]] || grep -q '^## Karpathy Principles' "$k"; then
281	          _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: no '## Karpathy Principles' section removed"; return 2
282	        fi
283	        local cj="$ws/.claude/data/constraints.json" cjn="none"
284	        if [[ -f "$cj" ]]; then
285	          # audit r1 DISS-C-008: a failed rewrite is exit 2, not a silent pass; verify afterwards
286	          jq '(.constraints // []) |= map(select((tostring | test("karpathy"; "i")) | not))' "$cj" > "$cj.tmp" \
287	            || { rm -f "$cj.tmp"; _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json could not be rewritten"; return 2; }
288	          mv "$cj.tmp" "$cj"
289	          cjn="$(jq '[(.constraints // [])[] | select(tostring | test("karpathy"; "i"))] | length' "$cj" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")"
290	          [[ "$cjn" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json still carries Karpathy rows ($cjn)"; return 2; }
291	        fi
292	        _sm_evidence karpathy_block "removed ${n} lines from CLAUDE.loa.md; constraints.json karpathy rows after: ${cjn}"
293	        ;;
294	      rule_files)
295	        local r gone=""
296	        for r in stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md; do
297	          if [[ -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]]; then rm -f "$ws/.claude/rules/$r"; gone="$gone $r"; fi
298	          [[ ! -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]] || { _sm_err "rule_files toggle: $r still present"; return 2; }
299	        done
300	        _sm_evidence rule_files "removed:${gone:- none present}"
301	        ;;
302	      audit_delta_instruction)
303	        local s="$ws/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
304	        [[ -f "$s" ]] || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no sandbox auditing-security/SKILL.md"; return 2; }
305	        _sm_drop_paragraph "$s" "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" \
306	          || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no delta paragraph found in the sandbox SKILL.md"; return 2; }
307	        _sm_evidence audit_delta_instruction "removed $(wc -c < "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" | tr -d ' ') bytes (.eval/arm-removed.txt)"
308	        ;;
309	      loa_mount)
310	        local p left=""
311	        for p in .claude CLAUDE.md .loa.config.yaml; do
312	          if [[ -e "$ws/$p" || -L "$ws/$p" ]]; then left="$left $p"; fi
313	        done
314	        [[ -z "$left" ]] || { _sm_err "loa_mount toggle: the sandbox still holds:$left (mount_prompt_surface must be skipped)"; return 2; }
315	        _sm_evidence loa_mount "none"
316	        ;;
317	      effort)
318	        local f total=0 stripped=0 still=""
319	        for f in "$ws"/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
320	          [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
321	          total=$((total + 1))
322	          if [[ "$(_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort "$f")" == "1" ]]; then stripped=$((stripped + 1)); fi
323	          if _sm_frontmatter_has_effort "$f"; then still="$still ${f#"$ws"/}"; fi
324	        done
325	        [[ -z "$still" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: effort: still in the frontmatter of:$still"; return 2; }
326	        local mc="$ws/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" cat_state="absent"
327	        if [[ -f "$mc" ]]; then
328	          local nkeys
329	          nkeys="$(yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort"))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
330	          [[ "$nkeys" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$nkeys" -gt 0 ]] \
331	            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: no default_effort key in the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
332	          V="$val" yq -i '(.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | .default_effort) = strenv(V)' "$mc" \
333	            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: yq failed on the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
334	          local wrong
335	          wrong="$(V="$val" yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | select(.default_effort != strenv(V))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 1)"
336	          [[ "$wrong" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: default_effort did not take effect"; return 2; }
337	          cat_state="default_effort=$val in $nkeys entries"
338	          if [[ -f "$mc.checksum" ]]; then
339	            local h
340	            h="$(_sm_sha256 "$mc" | awk '{print $1}')"
341	            [[ "$h" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: could not hash model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
342	            printf '%s\n' "$h" > "$mc.checksum"
343	            cat_state="$cat_state; .checksum refreshed"
344	          fi
345	        fi
346	        _sm_evidence effort "$val"
347	        _sm_evidence effort_skills_stripped "$stripped/$total"
348	        _sm_evidence effort_catalog "$cat_state"
349	        ;;
350	      gates)
351	        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled .flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled \
352	          || { _sm_err "gates toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
353	        export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
354	        if [[ -n "${ARM_ENV_FILE:-}" ]]; then printf 'LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false\n' >> "$ARM_ENV_FILE"; fi
355	        _sm_evidence gates "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false"
356	        _sm_evidence arm_env "LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false"
357	        ;;
358	      flatline)
359	        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.enabled \
360	          || { _sm_err "flatline toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
361	        _sm_evidence flatline "flatline_protocol.enabled=false"
362	        ;;
363	      sprint_plan)
364	        _sm_evidence sprint_plan "phase set without PLAN (pipeline executor); no sprint.md materialised"
365	        ;;
366	      context_resets)
367	        _sm_evidence context_resets "implementer phases continue one session (pipeline executor)"
368	        ;;
369	      *) _sm_err "arm '$arm' declares unknown toggle '$key'"; return 2 ;;
370	    esac
371	  done < <(jq -r 'to_entries[] | [.key, (.value | tostring)] | @tsv' <<<"$toggles")
372	  return 0
373	}

376	regen_sandbox_manifest() {
377	  local ws="$1"
378	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
379	  if [[ ! -d "$ws/.claude" ]]; then
380	    _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "none"
381	    return 0
382	  fi
383	  local out="$ws/.claude/checksums.json" tool="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT}/tools/gen-checksums.sh" how="inline"
384	  if [[ -x "$tool" ]] && git -C "$ws" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 \
385	     && [[ -n "$(git -C "$ws" ls-files .claude 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]]; then
386	    "$tool" --root "$ws" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $tool --root $ws failed"; return 2; }
387	    how="gen-checksums.sh"
388	  else
389	    local list="$ws/.eval/.manifest-files" sums="$ws/.eval/.manifest-sums"
390	    mkdir -p "$ws/.eval"
391	    ( cd "$ws" && find .claude -type f ! -path '.claude/overrides/*' ! -path '.claude/checksums.json' -print ) \
392	      | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
393	    if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: a path under .claude/ holds a backslash"; rm -f "$list"; return 2; fi
394	    : > "$sums"
395	    local -a batch=()
396	    local f
397	    while IFS= read -r f; do
398	      batch+=("$f")
399	      if [[ ${#batch[@]} -ge 200 ]]; then
400	        ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
401	        batch=()
402	      fi
403	    done < "$list"
404	    if [[ ${#batch[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
405	      ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
406	    fi
407	    jq -Rn --arg generated "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
408	      {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
409	       files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | capture("^(?<h>[0-9a-f]{64})  (?<p>.+)$") | {key: .p, value: .h}] | from_entries)}' \
410	      < "$sums" > "$out.tmp" || { rm -f "$out.tmp" "$list" "$sums"; _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: could not write the manifest"; return 2; }
411	    mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
412	    rm -f "$list" "$sums"
413	  fi
414	  jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $out is not a manifest"; return 2; }
415	  local digest
416	  digest="$(_sm_sha256 "$out" | awk '{print $1}')"
417	  _sm_evidence manifest_files "$(jq '.files | length' "$out") ($how)"
418	  _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "$digest"
419	  return 0
420	}

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# =============================================================================
3	# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
4	#
5	# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
6	# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
7	# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
8	# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
9	# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
10	#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
11	#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
12	# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
13	# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
14	# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
15	# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
16	# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
17	# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
18	# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
19	# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
20	# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
21	# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
22	# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
23	#
24	# Usage:
25	#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
26	#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
27	#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
28	#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
29	#
30	# Options:
31	#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
32	#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
33	#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
34	#                       alias --workspace
35	#   --run-id R          run id recorded in pipeline.json
36	#   --trial N           trial number
37	#   --source-tree DIR   the pinned Loa tree the mount is copied from
38	#   --suite-file F      evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (read with yq -o=json)
39	#   --max-run-usd USD   per-run cap (default 12; config evals.ablation.run_cap_usd)
40	#   --executor MODE     container (default; DEC-0411) or host
41	#   --image IMG         container image (default loa-ablation:258)
42	#   --claude-bin B      host-mode CLI (default $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
43	#   --docker-bin D      docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
44	#   --phase-models JSON {"PLAN": "<model id>", …} override ($LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS)
45	#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
46	#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created
47	#
48	# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
49	#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)
50	#   snapshots/   <label>.bundle + index.json ({IMPLEMENT|FIX1|FIX2: commit}) after
51	#                IMPLEMENT and each FIX
52	#   transcripts/ events-<label>.jsonl (stream-json), stderr-<label>.log
53	#   eval/        model-invoke.jsonl, cost-ledger.jsonl (copied out of
54	#                sandbox/.eval/ after every phase), adversarial-*.json
55	#   meta/        pipeline.json, phase-<label>.argv.json (argv + captured env),
56	#                prompt-<label>.md, arm, arm-evidence.txt, arm-env, refused.json,
57	#                home/ (container mode: the per-run HOME; deleted at exit)
58	#
59	# Session (D-4.3, DEC-0394 as amended, DEC-0412): `claude -p <prompt> --output-format
60	# stream-json --verbose --model <id> --permission-mode bypassPermissions
61	# --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project --tools <list>
62	# --max-turns <cap> [--effort <v>] [--resume <id>]`, cwd sandbox/, with exactly this
63	# environment: PATH HOME LANG LC_ALL TERM TMPDIR CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
64	# CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH
65	# GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GH_CONFIG_DIR=<sandbox/.eval/gh-empty>,
66	# the Bedrock route's pass-through keys when set in the driver's environment
67	# (AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
68	# ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL), and the
69	# arm's LOA_* variables (LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false for gates: false).
70	# A python3 -I exec shim closes every descriptor above 2 and keeps exactly those keys;
71	# values reach it through the environment, never argv, so AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
72	# appears in no argv, capture or log (phase-<label>.argv.json records it as "<set>").
73	# `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15` bounds the CLI.
74	# Container mode (D-4.9, DEC-0411 as amended) runs the same command inside
75	#   docker run --rm --name <n> --user <uid>:<gid> --network bridge --read-only
76	#     --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
77	#     -v <run>/sandbox:/workspace:rw -v <run>/meta/home:/home/evaluser:rw
78	#     -w /workspace -e <KEY=value…> -e AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK <image> python3 -I -c <shim> … claude …
79	# Exactly two mounts. meta/home/ (mode 0700) holds copies of $HOME/.codex/{auth.json,
80	# config.toml} when present and empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store
81	# lives there for the whole run, so A6's --resume works across phases. No ~/.claude
82	# file is ever copied. The directory is deleted at exit and on interrupt.
83	# image_digest = the image's RepoDigest or id (container), else the fingerprint (host).
84	# Versions: `fingerprint` is computed from the HOST toolchain; in container mode the
85	# toolchain that runs the phases is the image's (Claude Code 2.1.299, codex 0.137.0 by
86	# Dockerfile.ablation), so image_digest identifies the batch's versions. On 2026-10-15
87	# the host CLI was 2.1.300 while the image pins 2.1.299; every arm runs in the container.
88	#
89	# Cap and watchdog (D-4.6, D-4.10): while a phase runs the driver re-prices the
90	# stream's assistant-turn usage every $LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S seconds (default 1)
91	# from per-token prices fetched once per model (pricing.py; $LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON
92	# overrides) and SIGTERMs the phase when spent + estimate ≥ the cap (cap_turn
93	# recorded). After each phase the result's total_cost_usd (authoritative) plus the
94	# sandbox cost-ledger rows written during the phase are added; ≥ cap → cap_failure.
95	#
96	# Exit codes:
97	#   0  finished (any verdict)                                   status completed
98	#   1  agent error: a phase exited non-zero or timed out        status agent_error
99	#   2  infrastructure: usage, refused arm/type, mount/toggle failure, CLI/docker
100	#      or image missing, fixture path rule, leak guard          status infrastructure_error
101	#   3  cap failure (run stopped at the cap)                     status cap_failure
102	#   4  interrupted (SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP to the driver, or a phase killed from
103	#      outside)                                                 status interrupted
104	# pipeline.json is written for every exit except usage errors and --dry-run; it is
105	# rewritten with status `running` after each phase so a SIGKILLed driver leaves a
106	# record (ablation-row.sh reads `running` as interrupted).
107	#
108	# Env: EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS, LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON,
109	# LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S, LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME (where ~/.codex is read; default $HOME),
110	# LOA_EVAL_CONTAINER_CLAUDE_BIN (default claude), LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR.
111	#
112	# Mount library: lib/sandbox-mount.sh beside this script, sourced by a literal path.
113	# Exported to it: ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE, ARM_ENV_FILE (meta/arm-env), LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE.
114	#
115	# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (stub claude, stub docker, and a temporary
116	# copy of this harness whose lib/sandbox-mount.sh is the stub mount library).
117	# =============================================================================

243	phase_cap() {  # phase_cap <name> max_turns|timeout_min — task bounds > suite phase_defaults > built-in;

250	  fi
251	  if [[ -z "$v" ]]; then
252	    if [[ "$key" == max_turns ]]; then v="$(builtin_turns "$n")"; else v="$(builtin_tmin "$n")"; fi
253	  fi

330	if [[ -f "$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json" ]] && [[ "$(jq -r '.dry_run' "$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json")" == "false" ]]; then
331	  prev_src="$(jq -r '.source_commit' "$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json")"
332	  prev_model="$(jq -r '.model_id' "$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json")"
333	  [[ "$prev_src" == "$SRC_FULL" && "$prev_model" == "$MODEL" ]] \
334	    || die "batch $BATCH already holds results for source $prev_src / model $prev_model; use another --batch"
335	fi
336	write_manifest "$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json" false
337	LOG="$BATCH_DIR/run.log"
338	log() { printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u +%H:%M:%SZ)" "$*" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2; }
339	
340	STARTED="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
341	STATE="running"
342	# per-arm counters (indexed arrays parallel to ARMS — bash 3.2 has no maps)
343	DONE=() FAILED=() PLANNED=()
344	for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do DONE[$i]=0; FAILED[$i]=0; PLANNED[$i]=$(( ${#FIXTURES[@]} * TRIALS )); done
345	# spend accounting (--max-usd): batch spend, per-arm and pooled completed-cost sums
346	SPENT=0 CUT_JSON=null POOL_SUM=0 POOL_N=0
347	ARM_SUM=() ARM_N=()
348	for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do ARM_SUM[$i]=0; ARM_N[$i]=0; done
349	fadd() { awk -v a="$1" -v b="$2" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", a + b }'; }
350	arm_index() { local i; for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do [[ "${ARMS[$i]}" == "$1" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done; echo -1; }
351	
352	write_status() {
353	  local per='{}' i finished=null
354	  for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do
355	    per="$(jq -c --arg a "${ARMS[$i]}" --argjson d "${DONE[$i]}" --argjson f "${FAILED[$i]}" --argjson p "${PLANNED[$i]}" \
356	      '. + {($a): {trials_done: $d, trials_failed: $f, trials_planned: $p}}' <<<"$per")"
357	  done
358	  [[ "$STATE" != "running" ]] && finished="\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\""
359	  jq -n --arg state "$STATE" --argjson per "$per" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg model "$MODEL" \
360	    --arg started "$STARTED" --argjson finished "$finished" --arg batch "$BATCH" --arg suite "$SUITE" \
361	    --argjson cut "$CUT_JSON" --argjson screen "$SCREEN" --arg spent "$SPENT" --arg max_usd "$MAX_USD" \
362	    '{schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, batch: $batch, state: $state, per_arm: $per,
363	      source_commit: $src, model_id: $model, started: $started, finished: $finished}
364	     + (if $max_usd == "" then {} else {spend: {spent_usd: ($spent | tonumber), max_usd: ($max_usd | tonumber)}} end)
365	     + (if $cut == null then {} else {cut_reason: $cut.reason, cut: $cut} end)
366	     + (if $screen then {screen: true} else {} end)' > "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp"
367	  mv "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
368	  # a screening batch never touches the suite-level aggregate (bd-j4lwr)
369	  [[ "$SCREEN" == "true" ]] || aggregate_status
370	}
371	
372	# The suite-level STATUS.json merges every batch: counters add per arm; the
373	# state is failed > running > partial > complete; source/model must agree.
374	aggregate_status() {
375	  local agg="$SUITE_DIR/STATUS.json" lockd="$SUITE_DIR/.status.lock" n=0
376	  until mkdir "$lockd" 2>/dev/null; do n=$((n + 1)); [[ $n -gt 50 ]] && return 0; sleep 0.1; done
377	  # shellcheck disable=SC2046
378	  jq -s --arg suite "$SUITE" '
379	    def rank: {"failed": 4, "running": 3, "partial": 2, "complete": 1}[.] // 4;
380	    (map(.state) | max_by(rank)) as $state |
381	    {schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, state: $state,
382	     batches: map({batch, state, started, finished}),
383	     cuts: [.[] | select(.cut != null) | .cut + {batch}],
384	     per_arm: (reduce (.[] | .per_arm | to_entries[]) as $e ({};
385	        .[$e.key] |= {trials_done: ((.trials_done // 0) + $e.value.trials_done),
386	                      trials_failed: ((.trials_failed // 0) + $e.value.trials_failed),
387	                      trials_planned: ((.trials_planned // 0) + $e.value.trials_planned)})),
388	     source_commit: (map(.source_commit) | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else "MIXED" end),
389	     model_id: (map(.model_id) | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else "MIXED" end),
390	     started: (map(.started) | min), finished: (if $state == "running" then null else (map(.finished) | max) end)}' \
391	    $(find "$SUITE_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name STATUS.json ! -path "$SUITE_DIR/screen-*" | sort) > "$agg.tmp" 2>/dev/null \
392	    && mv "$agg.tmp" "$agg"
393	  rmdir "$lockd" 2>/dev/null || true
394	}
395	set_state() { STATE="$1"; write_status; }
396	
397	# --- one trial (runs in a background job; writes its row to $JOBS_DIR/<id>.row)
398	is_transport_failure() {  # is_transport_failure <sandbox-ws>
399	  local ws="$1" out="$1/.eval/agent-output.json" err="$1/.eval/agent-stderr.log" rc
400	  rc="$(jq -r '.exit_code // 0' "$ws/.eval/executor.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
401	  case "$rc" in 124|137|143) return 0 ;; esac
402	  [[ "$(jq -r '.subtype // ""' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" == "missing" ]] && return 0
403	  [[ -n "$(jq -r '.api_error_status // empty' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" ]] && return 0
404	  # audit r1 DISS-C-005: classify on the CLI's stderr only, never on the agent's own
405	  # output, so the agent under test cannot earn itself a retry by mentioning a network
406	  # error; the patterns are the CLI's transport messages, not free text.
407	  grep -qiE 'rate.?limit|overloaded|session limit|usage limit|out of extra usage|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|socket hang up|^(fetch|request) failed|HTTP 5[0-9][0-9]' \
408	    "$err" 2>/dev/null && return 0
409	  return 1
410	}
411	
412	run_trial() {  # run_trial <job-id> <arm> <fixture> <trial>
413	  local jid="$1" arm="$2" fx="$3" trial="$4"
414	  local task="$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$fx.yaml" task_id="$TASK_PREFIX-$fx"
415	  local run_id="arms-$SUITE-$BATCH" attempt=0 ws="" trial_id status="error" err_json='null'
416	  local graders='[]' composite='{"strategy":"all_must_pass","pass":false,"score":0}' executor='null'
417	  local start_ms end_ms per_trial ex_rc
418	  per_trial="$(yq -r '.timeout.per_trial // 1500' "$task")"
419	  start_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
420	  if ! verify_corpus "$fx" >"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.digest" 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift"; then
421	    printf 'DRIFT\n' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag"; return 0
422	  fi
423	  while [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; do
424	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
425	    trial_id="$run_id-$arm-$fx-t$trial-a$attempt-$jid"
426	    ws="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" create --fixture "review-prs/$fx" --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" 2>/dev/null)" \
427	      || { err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"sandbox creation failed"}'; break; }
428	    ex_rc=0
429	    # audit r1 DISS-C-001: the arm's toggles come from the suite declaration only; a
430	    # LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES inherited from the parent environment never reaches a trial
431	    env -u LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES \
432	      EVAL_PROMPT_TREE="$WORKTREE" EVAL_MODEL="$MODEL" LOA_EVAL_ARM="$arm" LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE="$SUITE_FILE" \
433	      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT="$SRC_FULL" LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1 \
434	      "$SCRIPT_DIR/execute-agent.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
435	        --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" --timeout "$per_trial" \
436	        >/dev/null 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log" || ex_rc=$?
437	    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/executor.json" ]] && executor="$(cat "$ws/.eval/executor.json")"
438	    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 0 ]]; then
439	      local gout gexit=0
440	      gout="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/grade.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
441	        --timeout "$(yq -r '.timeout.per_grader // 60' "$task")" 2>/dev/null)" || gexit=$?
442	      if jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$gout"; then
443	        graders="$(jq -c '.graders' <<<"$gout")"; composite="$(jq -c '.composite' <<<"$gout")"
444	      fi
445	      if [[ $gexit -le 1 ]]; then status="completed"; err_json='null'
446	      else err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"grader error"}'; fi
447	      break
448	    fi
449	    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 1 ]] && is_transport_failure "$ws"; then
450	      err_json="$(jq -cn --argjson a "$attempt" '{type:"transport_error",message:"executor transport failure",attempt:$a}')"
451	      if [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; then
452	        keep_artifacts "$ws" "$arm" "$task_id" "$trial" "-attempt1"
453	        "$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" destroy --trial-id "$trial_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
454	        ws=""; executor='null'
455	        sleep "$RETRY_WAIT"; continue
456	      fi
457	    else
458	      err_json="$(jq -cn --argjson rc "$ex_rc" '{type:(if $rc == 2 then "infrastructure_error" else "agent_error" end),message:("execute-agent exit " + ($rc|tostring))}')"
459	    fi
460	    break
461	  done
462	  end_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
463	  if [[ -n "$ws" && -d "$ws" ]]; then
464	    keep_artifacts "$ws" "$arm" "$task_id" "$trial" ""
465	    "$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" destroy --trial-id "$trial_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
466	  fi
467	  jq -cn --arg run_id "$run_id" --arg batch "$BATCH" --arg suite "$SUITE" --arg task_id "$task_id" \
468	    --arg fixture "$fx" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson trial "$trial" --argjson attempts "$attempt" \
469	    --arg status "$status" --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg run_date "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)" \
470	    --argjson duration_ms "$(( end_ms - start_ms ))" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg model_req "$MODEL" \
471	    --argjson executor "$executor" --argjson graders "$graders" --argjson composite "$composite" \
472	    --argjson error "$err_json" --arg digest "$CORPUS_DIGEST" --arg digest_now "$(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.digest" 2>/dev/null)" \
473	    '{schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, batch: $batch, suite: $suite, task_id: $task_id, fixture: $fixture,
474	      arm: $arm, trial: $trial, attempts: $attempts, status: $status, timestamp: $ts, run_date: $run_date,
475	      duration_ms: $duration_ms, source_commit: $src, model_requested: $model_req,
476	      model_id: ($executor.model_id? // null), model_version: ($executor.model_id? // "none"), seed: null,
477	      corpus_sha256: $digest, corpus_sha256_at_trial: $digest_now, fixture_verified: true, graders: $graders, composite: $composite, error: $error}
478	     + (if $executor == null then {} else {executor: $executor} end)' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp"
479	  mv "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"
480	}
481	
482	keep_artifacts() {  # keep_artifacts <ws> <arm> <task_id> <trial> <suffix>
483	  local ws="$1" dest="$BATCH_DIR/$2/artifacts/$3/trial-$4$5" f
484	  mkdir -p "$dest"
485	  for f in executor.json agent-output.json agent-stderr.log arm-removed.txt; do
486	    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/$f" "$dest/$f"
487	  done
488	  for f in review.md audit.md; do [[ -f "$ws/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/$f" "$dest/$f"; done
489	  # the raw transcript only on request (it embeds every tool result)
490	  [[ "${EVAL_KEEP_EVENTS:-0}" == "1" && -f "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" "$dest/events.jsonl"
491	  return 0
492	}
493	
494	# Parent-side: append a finished job's row and update the counters.
495	collect() {  # collect <job-id> <arm>
496	  local jid="$1" arm="$2" i
497	  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
498	  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag" ]]; then
499	    log "corpus drift before $jid: $(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift" 2>/dev/null)"
500	    set_state failed; exit 3
501	  fi
502	  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" ]]; then
503	    mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR/$arm"
504	    cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" >> "$BATCH_DIR/$arm/results.jsonl"
505	    local cost
506	    cost="$(jq -r '(.executor.total_cost_usd // 0) | tonumber? // 0' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
507	    [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
508	    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
509	    if [[ "$(jq -r '.status' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")" == "completed" ]]; then
510	      ARM_SUM[$i]="$(fadd "${ARM_SUM[$i]}" "$cost")"; ARM_N[$i]=$(( ${ARM_N[$i]} + 1 ))
511	      POOL_SUM="$(fadd "$POOL_SUM" "$cost")"; POOL_N=$((POOL_N + 1))
512	    fi
513	    if [[ "$(jq -r '.status' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")" == "completed" ]]; then
514	      DONE[$i]=$(( ${DONE[$i]} + 1 ))
515	      log "done $jid ($(jq -r '"\(.arm) \(.fixture) t\(.trial) recall=\(([.graders[]? | select(.name=="recall-vs-defects.sh") | .details.recall][0]) // "n/a") \(.duration_ms/1000|floor)s"' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
516	    else
517	      FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
518	      log "FAILED $jid ($(jq -c '.error' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
519	    fi
520	    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*
521	  else
522	    FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
523	    log "FAILED $jid (no row written; see $JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log)"
524	  fi
525	  write_status
526	}
527	
528	log "start suite=$SUITE batch=$BATCH source=$SRC12 model=$MODEL trials=${#PLAN[@]} concurrency=$CONCURRENCY worktree=$WORKTREE"
529	write_status
530	trap 'log "interrupted"; set_state failed; exit 3' INT TERM HUP
531	
532	PIDS=() PJOB=() PARM=()
533	reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
534	  local i
535	  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
536	    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
537	      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then
538	        wait "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true
539	        collect "${PJOB[$i]}" "${PARM[$i]}"
540	        unset 'PIDS[i]' 'PJOB[i]' 'PARM[i]'
541	        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]+"${PIDS[@]}"}"); PJOB=("${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}"); PARM=("${PARM[@]+"${PARM[@]}"}")
542	        break
543	      fi
544	    done
545	    [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]] && sleep 1
546	  done
547	  return 0
548	}
549	
550	# est_next <arm> — the next trial's expected cost (see the header)
551	est_next() {
552	  local i; i="$(arm_index "$1")"
553	  if [[ "${ARM_N[$i]}" -gt 0 ]]; then awk -v s="${ARM_SUM[$i]}" -v n="${ARM_N[$i]}" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", s / n }'
554	  elif [[ "$POOL_N" -gt 0 ]]; then awk -v s="$POOL_SUM" -v n="$POOL_N" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", s / n }'
555	  else printf '%s' "$COST_HINT"; fi
556	}
557	# budget_gate <arm> <trial-number> — 0 launch; 1 cut (CUT_JSON set). Waits for a
558	# running trial while only the in-flight reservation blocks the launch.
559	budget_gate() {
560	  local arm="$1" at="$2" est inflight reserved
561	  while true; do
562	    est="$(est_next "$arm")"; inflight=${#PIDS[@]}
563	    reserved="$(awk -v k="$inflight" -v c="$RUN_CAP" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", k * c }')"
564	    if awk -v s="$SPENT" -v e="$est" -v m="$MAX_USD" 'BEGIN { exit !(s + e > m) }'; then
565	      CUT_JSON="$(jq -cn --arg s "$SPENT" --arg r "$reserved" --arg m "$MAX_USD" --arg e "$est" \
566	        --argjson launched "$LAUNCHED" --argjson at "$at" \
567	        '{reason: "max_usd", spent: ($s | tonumber), in_flight_reserved: ($r | tonumber), max: ($m | tonumber),
568	          est_next: ($e | tonumber), trials_launched: $launched, at_trial: $at}')"
569	      log "cut: max_usd $MAX_USD reached after $LAUNCHED trials (spent $SPENT, in-flight reserved $reserved, next est $est; trial $at not launched; reason recorded in STATUS.json)"
570	      return 1
571	    fi
572	    if awk -v s="$SPENT" -v r="$reserved" -v e="$est" -v m="$MAX_USD" 'BEGIN { exit !(s + r + e > m) }'; then
573	      reap "$inflight"; continue
574	    fi
575	    return 0
576	  done
577	}
578	
579	n=0 LAUNCHED=0
580	for p in "${PLAN[@]}"; do
581	  IFS='|' read -r a f t <<<"$p"
582	  n=$((n + 1)); jid="$(printf 'j%04d' "$n")"
583	  reap "$CONCURRENCY"
584	  if [[ -n "$MAX_USD" ]] && ! budget_gate "$a" "$n"; then break; fi
585	  run_trial "$jid" "$a" "$f" "$t" &
586	  PIDS+=("$!"); PJOB+=("$jid"); PARM+=("$a")
587	  LAUNCHED=$((LAUNCHED + 1))
588	done
589	reap 1
590	
591	# --screen: the per-arm table on stdout (from this batch's rows)
592	print_screen_table() {
593	  printf '%-24s %6s %9s %11s\n' arm trials mean_usd mean_recall
594	  local a
595	  for a in "${ARMS[@]}"; do
596	    if [[ -f "$BATCH_DIR/$a/results.jsonl" ]]; then
597	      jq -rs --arg a "$a" '
598	        def mean: if length == 0 then null else (add / length) end;
599	        [ .[] | (.executor.total_cost_usd // 0) ] as $c |
600	        [ .[] | select(.status == "completed") | ([.graders[]? | select(.name == "recall-vs-defects.sh") | .details.recall][0]) | select(. != null) ] as $r |
601	        [$a, (length | tostring), (($c | mean) // 0 | . * 100 | round / 100 | tostring),
602	         (($r | mean) as $m | if $m == null then "n/a" else ($m * 1000 | round / 1000 | tostring) end)] | @tsv' \
603	        "$BATCH_DIR/$a/results.jsonl" | awk -F'\t' '{ printf "%-24s %6s %9s %11s\n", $1, $2, $3, $4 }'
604	    else
605	      printf '%-24s %6s %9s %11s\n' "$a" 0 0 n/a
606	    fi
607	  done
608	}
609	finish() {  # finish <state> <exit> <message>
610	  set_state "$1"; log "$3"
611	  if [[ "$SCREEN" == "true" ]]; then
612	    echo "screen: suite=$SUITE fixtures=$(IFS=,; echo "${FIXTURES[*]}") (1 trial each) batch=$BATCH_DIR"
613	    print_screen_table
614	  fi
615	  exit "$2"
616	}
617	
618	total_done=0 total_failed=0
619	for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do total_done=$(( total_done + ${DONE[$i]} )); total_failed=$(( total_failed + ${FAILED[$i]} )); done
620	if [[ "$CUT_JSON" != "null" ]]; then
621	  finish partial 1 "partial (cut max_usd): $total_done done, $total_failed failed, $LAUNCHED of ${#PLAN[@]} launched, spent $SPENT"
622	elif [[ $total_failed -eq 0 ]]; then
623	  finish complete 0 "complete: $total_done trials"
624	elif [[ $total_done -eq 0 ]]; then
625	  finish failed 3 "failed: no trial completed ($total_failed failed)"
626	else
627	  finish partial 1 "partial: $total_done done, $total_failed failed"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# evals/tests/spend.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.5 (PRD FR-2 AC-2.3, SDD §5.11)
     4	#
     5	# spend.sh sums run rows (cost_usd, each run_id once across files) and the cost
     6	# ledger (cost_micro_usd, ts >= since) and prints total, components, cap,
     7	# headroom and reserve. Fixtures: evals/tests/fixtures/ablation/spend/ —
     8	# runs.jsonl 6.41 + 3.59, rows.jsonl 3.59 (same run_id, counted once) + 2.00,
     9	# ledger 1.00 before the kickoff, 2.50 and 0.50 after it.
    10	# =============================================================================
    11	
    12	setup() {
    13	  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
    14	  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    15	  SPEND="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/spend.sh"
    16	  FX="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation/spend"
    17	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/sp.XXXXXX")"
    18	}
    19	
    20	teardown() {
    21	  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
    22	  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
    23	}
    24	
    25	@test "SP-1 rows (deduplicated by run_id) plus ledger rows since the default kickoff: the summary line" {
    26	  run "$SPEND" --runs "$FX/runs.jsonl" "$FX/rows.jsonl" --ledger "$FX/cost-ledger.jsonl"
    27	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    28	  [ "$output" = "cycle spend USD 15.00 (runs 12.00 + ledger 3.00 since 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z); cap 1,500; headroom 1,485.00; reserve 250" ]
    29	}
    30	
    31	@test "SP-2 --json carries the same fields" {
    32	  run "$SPEND" --runs "$FX/runs.jsonl" --runs "$FX/rows.jsonl" --ledger "$FX/cost-ledger.jsonl" --json
    33	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    34	  [ "$(jq -r '.total_usd' <<<"$output")" = "15" ]
    35	  [ "$(jq -r '.runs_usd' <<<"$output")" = "12" ]
    36	  [ "$(jq -r '.ledger_usd' <<<"$output")" = "3" ]
    37	  [ "$(jq -r '.since' <<<"$output")" = "2026-10-14T13:50:00Z" ]
    38	  [ "$(jq -r '.cap_usd' <<<"$output")" = "1500" ]
    39	  [ "$(jq -r '.headroom_usd' <<<"$output")" = "1485" ]
    40	  [ "$(jq -r '.reserve_usd' <<<"$output")" = "250" ]

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash

     6	# TRACKED `.claude/` tree only. The legacy generators (mount-loa.sh and
     7	# update.sh `generate_checksums`) walk the working tree with `find`, so build,
     8	# cache and runtime artefacts (`__pycache__`, `.pytest_cache`, `node_modules`,
     9	# `.run/`) that exist only on the generating machine end up in the manifest and
    10	# read as Missing on every fresh mount. This generator lists
    11	#
    12	#   git -C ROOT ls-files -z -- .claude

    15	# manifest itself (`.claude/checksums.json`), hashes each with
    16	# `sha256_portable` (.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh) and writes
    17	#
    18	#   {"generated": "<UTC ISO-8601>", "algorithm": "sha256",
    19	#    "files": {"<path>": "<sha256 hex>", ...}}
    20	#
    21	# pretty-printed by jq (2-space), keys in `LC_ALL=C` byte order. Two runs on
    22	# the same tree are byte-identical except `generated`. The working-tree content
    23	# of each tracked path is hashed (an unstaged edit is reflected); a tracked
    24	# path deleted from the working tree is skipped with a warning on stderr.
    25	#
    26	# Usage:
    27	#   tools/gen-checksums.sh [--root DIR] [--out FILE]   # (re)generate
    28	#   tools/gen-checksums.sh --check [--root DIR] [--out FILE]
    29	#
    30	# Options:
    31	#   --root DIR   repository work tree to read (default: the git top level of
    32	#                the current directory)
    33	#   --out FILE   manifest path (default: ROOT/.claude/checksums.json). With
    34	#                --check this is the committed manifest that is compared.
    35	#   --check      regenerate to a temp file and compare its `files` map with
    36	#                the manifest at --out; nothing is written
    37	#   -h, --help   this text
    38	#
    39	# Exit codes:
    40	#   0  generated, or --check: the `files` maps are identical
    41	#   1  --check: drift (the first ten differing paths, each labelled added /
    42	#      removed / changed, on stderr) or the manifest is absent / not JSON
    43	#   2  usage error, ROOT is not a git work tree, or a tracked path name that
    44	#      cannot be represented safely (newline, tab or backslash)
    45	# =============================================================================
    46	set -euo pipefail
    47	export LC_ALL=C
    48	
    49	SELF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    50	# shellcheck source=../.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh
    51	source "${SELF_DIR}/../.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
    52	
    53	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    54	die2() { echo "gen-checksums: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    55	
    56	MANIFEST_REL=".claude/checksums.json"
    57	ROOT=""
    58	OUT=""
    59	CHECK=0
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --check) CHECK=1; shift ;;
    63	    --root)
    64	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--root requires a directory"
    65	      ROOT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    66	    --out)
    67	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--out requires a file path"
    68	      OUT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    69	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    70	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    71	  esac
    72	done
    73	
    74	if [[ -z "$ROOT" ]]; then
    75	  ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "not inside a git work tree (use --root DIR)"

    80	  || die2 "not a git work tree: $ROOT"
    81	[[ -n "$OUT" ]] || OUT="${ROOT}/${MANIFEST_REL}"
    82	
    83	TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gen-checksums.XXXXXX")"
    84	cleanup() { rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"; }
    85	trap cleanup EXIT
    86	
    87	# --- 1. the tracked set (NUL-safe, C-sorted, overrides and manifest removed) --
    88	files=()
    89	while IFS= read -r -d '' path; do
    90	  case "$path" in
    91	    .claude/overrides/*|"$MANIFEST_REL") continue ;;
    92	  esac
    93	  case "$path" in
    94	    *$'\n'*|*$'\t'*|*\\*) die2 "refusing a tracked path with a newline, tab or backslash: $(printf '%q' "$path")" ;;
    95	  esac
    96	  if [[ ! -f "${ROOT}/${path}" ]]; then
    97	    # A gitlink, a dangling symlink or a path deleted in the working tree.
    98	    echo "gen-checksums: warning: tracked path not a file in the working tree, skipped: $path" >&2
    99	    continue
   100	  fi
   101	  files+=("$path")
   102	done < <(git -C "$ROOT" ls-files -z -- .claude | sort -z)
   103	
   104	# --- 2. hash in chunks (one sha256 process per 400 paths, order preserved) ----
   105	TSV="${TMP_DIR}/files.tsv"
   106	: > "$TSV"
   107	n=${#files[@]}
   108	i=0
   109	while [[ $i -lt $n ]]; do
   110	  chunk=("${files[@]:i:400}")
   111	  hashes=()
   112	  while IFS= read -r line; do
   113	    hashes+=("${line%% *}")
   114	  done < <(cd "$ROOT" && sha256_portable "${chunk[@]}")
   115	  [[ ${#hashes[@]} -eq ${#chunk[@]} ]] || die2 "sha256 returned ${#hashes[@]} digests for ${#chunk[@]} paths"
   116	  j=0
   117	  while [[ $j -lt ${#chunk[@]} ]]; do
   118	    [[ "${hashes[j]}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || die2 "unexpected sha256 output for ${chunk[j]}"
   119	    printf '%s\t%s\n' "${chunk[j]}" "${hashes[j]}" >> "$TSV"
   120	    j=$((j + 1))
   121	  done
   122	  i=$((i + 400))
   123	done
   124	[[ $n -gt 0 ]] || echo "gen-checksums: warning: no tracked files under .claude in $ROOT" >&2
   125	
   126	GEN="${TMP_DIR}/checksums.json"
   127	jq -Rn --arg generated "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
   128	  {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
   129	   files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | split("\t") | {key: .[0], value: .[1]}] | from_entries)}
   130	' < "$TSV" > "$GEN"
   131	
   132	# --- 3a. write ----------------------------------------------------------------
   133	if [[ $CHECK -eq 0 ]]; then
   134	  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
   135	  chmod 0644 "$GEN"
   136	  # mv replaces a symlinked manifest instead of writing through it.
   137	  mv -f "$GEN" "$OUT"
   138	  echo "gen-checksums: wrote $n entries to $OUT" >&2
   139	  exit 0
   140	fi
   141	
   142	# --- 3b. --check --------------------------------------------------------------
   143	if [[ ! -f "$OUT" ]]; then
   144	  echo "gen-checksums: --check: manifest not found: $OUT (run tools/gen-checksums.sh)" >&2
   145	  exit 1
   146	fi
   147	if ! jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$OUT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   148	  echo "gen-checksums: --check: manifest is not JSON with a files object: $OUT" >&2
   149	  exit 1
   150	fi
   151	DIFF="${TMP_DIR}/diff.txt"
   152	jq -rn --slurpfile old "$OUT" --slurpfile new "$GEN" '
   153	  ($old[0].files) as $o | ($new[0].files) as $n |
   154	  ( [ $n | keys[] | . as $p | select($o | has($p) | not) | {p: $p, k: "added"} ]
   155	  + [ $o | keys[] | . as $p | select($n | has($p) | not) | {p: $p, k: "removed"} ]
   156	  + [ $n | keys[] | . as $p | select(($o | has($p)) and $o[$p] != $n[$p]) | {p: $p, k: "changed"} ] )
   157	  | sort_by(.p) | .[] | "\(.k): \(.p)"
   158	' > "$DIFF"
   159	count=$(wc -l < "$DIFF" | tr -d ' ')
   160	if [[ "$count" -eq 0 ]]; then
   161	  echo "gen-checksums: --check: OK ($n entries match $OUT)" >&2
   162	  exit 0
   163	fi
   164	echo "gen-checksums: --check: DRIFT — $count path(s) differ between $OUT and the tracked tree:" >&2
   165	sed -n '1,10s/^/  /p' "$DIFF" >&2
   166	[[ "$count" -le 10 ]] || echo "  ... and $((count - 10)) more" >&2
   167	echo "gen-checksums: regenerate with: bash tools/gen-checksums.sh" >&2
   168	exit 1

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/check-manifest-paths.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.2, DEC-0368)
     4	#
     5	# CI gate for the System Zone integrity manifest: every path listed in
     6	# `.claude/checksums.json` must be TRACKED (`git ls-files -- .claude`) and
     7	# PRESENT in the working tree. A manifest generated by walking a dirty tree
     8	# (the #1267 class) lists build, cache and runtime artefacts that no fresh
     9	# mount has, so every downstream `check-loa.sh` reports them as Missing.
    10	#
    11	# Offenders are grouped on stderr:
    12	#   untracked  — listed in the manifest, not in `git ls-files`; each carries a
    13	#                DIAGNOSTIC class (first match wins):
    14	#                  __pycache__ | .pytest_cache | node_modules | .run
    15	#                      (a path component of that name)
    16	#                  .pyc   (name ends in .pyc)
    17	#                  .lock  (name ends in .lock)
    18	#                  other
    19	#   missing    — tracked, but absent from the working tree
    20	# The classes label untracked offenders only: a TRACKED path is never flagged
    21	# for its name (a committed `.lock` fixture is legitimate).
    22	#
    23	# Last line on stdout:
    24	#   manifest-paths: N entries, M untracked (class=count, ...), K missing
    25	#
    26	# Usage:
    27	#   tools/check-manifest-paths.sh [--manifest FILE] [--root DIR]
    28	#
    29	# Options:
    30	#   --root DIR       repository work tree (default: the git top level of the
    31	#                    current directory)
    32	#   --manifest FILE  manifest to check (default: ROOT/.claude/checksums.json)
    33	#   -h, --help       this text
    34	#
    35	# Exit codes:
    36	#   0  every manifest path is tracked and present
    37	#   1  at least one untracked or missing path (listed on stderr)
    38	#   2  usage error, ROOT is not a git work tree, or the manifest is absent or
    39	#      not JSON with a `files` object
    40	# =============================================================================
    41	set -euo pipefail
    42	export LC_ALL=C
    43	
    44	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    45	die2() { echo "check-manifest-paths: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    46	
    47	ROOT=""
    48	MANIFEST=""
    49	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    50	  case "$1" in
    51	    --root)
    52	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--root requires a directory"
    53	      ROOT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    54	    --manifest)
    55	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--manifest requires a file path"
    56	      MANIFEST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    57	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    58	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    59	  esac
    60	done
    61	
    62	if [[ -z "$ROOT" ]]; then
    63	  ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "not inside a git work tree (use --root DIR)"
    64	fi
    65	[[ -d "$ROOT" ]] || die2 "--root is not a directory: $ROOT"
    66	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd -P)"
    67	[[ "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null || true)" == "true" ]] \
    68	  || die2 "not a git work tree: $ROOT"
    69	[[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]] || MANIFEST="${ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json"
    70	[[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || die2 "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
    71	jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$MANIFEST" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    72	  || die2 "manifest is not JSON with a files object: $MANIFEST"
    73	
    74	TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/check-manifest-paths.XXXXXX")"
    75	cleanup() { rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"; }
    76	trap cleanup EXIT
    77	
    78	# Both lists newline-separated and C-sorted. A path with a newline cannot be
    79	# represented in either list; gen-checksums.sh refuses to emit one.
    80	git -C "$ROOT" ls-files -- .claude | sort -u > "${TMP_DIR}/tracked"
    81	jq -r '.files | keys[]' "$MANIFEST" | sort -u > "${TMP_DIR}/listed"
    82	comm -23 "${TMP_DIR}/listed" "${TMP_DIR}/tracked" > "${TMP_DIR}/untracked"
    83	comm -12 "${TMP_DIR}/listed" "${TMP_DIR}/tracked" > "${TMP_DIR}/both"
    84	
    85	classify() {
    86	  local p="$1"
    87	  if [[ "$p" =~ (^|/)(__pycache__|\.pytest_cache|node_modules|\.run)(/|$) ]]; then
    88	    printf '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
    89	  elif [[ "$p" == *.pyc ]]; then
    90	    printf '.pyc'
    91	  elif [[ "$p" == *.lock ]]; then
    92	    printf '.lock'
    93	  else
    94	    printf 'other'
    95	  fi
    96	}
    97	
    98	# Classified untracked offenders: "<class>\t<path>"
    99	: > "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls"
   100	while IFS= read -r p; do
   101	  [[ -n "$p" ]] || continue
   102	  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$(classify "$p")" "$p" >> "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls"
   103	done < "${TMP_DIR}/untracked"
   104	
   105	: > "${TMP_DIR}/missing"
   106	while IFS= read -r p; do
   107	  [[ -n "$p" ]] || continue
   108	  [[ -e "${ROOT}/${p}" ]] || printf '%s\n' "$p" >> "${TMP_DIR}/missing"
   109	done < "${TMP_DIR}/both"
   110	
   111	entries=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/listed" | tr -d ' ')
   112	n_untracked=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" | tr -d ' ')
   113	n_missing=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/missing" | tr -d ' ')
   114	
   115	class_summary=""
   116	if [[ "$n_untracked" -gt 0 ]]; then
   117	  echo "check-manifest-paths: untracked manifest paths (not in git ls-files -- .claude), by class:" >&2
   118	  for cls in __pycache__ .pytest_cache node_modules .run .pyc .lock other; do
   119	    c=$(awk -F'\t' -v c="$cls" '$1 == c' "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
   120	    [[ "$c" -gt 0 ]] || continue
   121	    class_summary="${class_summary:+${class_summary}, }${cls}=${c}"
   122	    echo "  [${cls}] ${c} path(s):" >&2
   123	    awk -F'\t' -v c="$cls" '$1 == c { print "    " $2 }' "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" >&2
   124	  done
   125	fi
   126	if [[ "$n_missing" -gt 0 ]]; then
   127	  echo "check-manifest-paths: tracked manifest paths absent from the working tree:" >&2
   128	  sed 's/^/    /' "${TMP_DIR}/missing" >&2
   129	fi
   130	
   131	echo "manifest-paths: ${entries} entries, ${n_untracked} untracked${class_summary:+ (${class_summary})}, ${n_missing} missing"
   132	if [[ "$n_untracked" -gt 0 || "$n_missing" -gt 0 ]]; then
   133	  echo "check-manifest-paths: FAIL — regenerate with: bash tools/gen-checksums.sh" >&2
   134	  exit 1
   135	fi
   136	exit 0

    12	#   untracked  — listed in the manifest, not in `git ls-files`; each carries a
    13	#                DIAGNOSTIC class (first match wins):
    14	#                  __pycache__ | .pytest_cache | node_modules | .run
    15	#                      (a path component of that name)
    16	#                  .pyc   (name ends in .pyc)
    17	#                  .lock  (name ends in .lock)
    18	#                  other
    19	#   missing    — tracked, but absent from the working tree
    20	# The classes label untracked offenders only: a TRACKED path is never flagged
    21	# for its name (a committed `.lock` fixture is legitimate).
    22	#
    23	# Last line on stdout:
    24	#   manifest-paths: N entries, M untracked (class=count, ...), K missing
    25	#
    26	# Usage:
    27	#   tools/check-manifest-paths.sh [--manifest FILE] [--root DIR]
    28	#
    29	# Options:
    30	#   --root DIR       repository work tree (default: the git top level of the
    31	#                    current directory)
    32	#   --manifest FILE  manifest to check (default: ROOT/.claude/checksums.json)
    33	#   -h, --help       this text
    34	#
    35	# Exit codes:
    36	#   0  every manifest path is tracked and present
    37	#   1  at least one untracked or missing path (listed on stderr)
    38	#   2  usage error, ROOT is not a git work tree, or the manifest is absent or
    39	#      not JSON with a `files` object
    40	# =============================================================================
    41	set -euo pipefail
    42	export LC_ALL=C
    43	
    44	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    45	die2() { echo "check-manifest-paths: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    46	
    47	ROOT=""
    48	MANIFEST=""
    49	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    50	  case "$1" in
    51	    --root)
    52	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--root requires a directory"
    53	      ROOT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    54	    --manifest)
    55	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--manifest requires a file path"
    56	      MANIFEST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    57	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    58	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    59	  esac
    60	done
    61	
    62	if [[ -z "$ROOT" ]]; then
    63	  ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "not inside a git work tree (use --root DIR)"
    64	fi
    65	[[ -d "$ROOT" ]] || die2 "--root is not a directory: $ROOT"
    66	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd -P)"
    67	[[ "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null || true)" == "true" ]] \
    68	  || die2 "not a git work tree: $ROOT"
    69	[[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]] || MANIFEST="${ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json"
    70	[[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || die2 "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
    71	jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$MANIFEST" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    72	  || die2 "manifest is not JSON with a files object: $MANIFEST"
    73	
    74	TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/check-manifest-paths.XXXXXX")"
    75	cleanup() { rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"; }
    76	trap cleanup EXIT
    77	
    78	# Both lists newline-separated and C-sorted. A path with a newline cannot be
    79	# represented in either list; gen-checksums.sh refuses to emit one.
    80	git -C "$ROOT" ls-files -- .claude | sort -u > "${TMP_DIR}/tracked"
    81	jq -r '.files | keys[]' "$MANIFEST" | sort -u > "${TMP_DIR}/listed"
    82	comm -23 "${TMP_DIR}/listed" "${TMP_DIR}/tracked" > "${TMP_DIR}/untracked"
    83	comm -12 "${TMP_DIR}/listed" "${TMP_DIR}/tracked" > "${TMP_DIR}/both"
    84	
    85	classify() {
    86	  local p="$1"
    87	  if [[ "$p" =~ (^|/)(__pycache__|\.pytest_cache|node_modules|\.run)(/|$) ]]; then
    88	    printf '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
    89	  elif [[ "$p" == *.pyc ]]; then
    90	    printf '.pyc'
    91	  elif [[ "$p" == *.lock ]]; then
    92	    printf '.lock'
    93	  else
    94	    printf 'other'
    95	  fi
    96	}
    97	
    98	# Classified untracked offenders: "<class>\t<path>"
    99	: > "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls"
   100	while IFS= read -r p; do
   101	  [[ -n "$p" ]] || continue
   102	  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$(classify "$p")" "$p" >> "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls"
   103	done < "${TMP_DIR}/untracked"
   104	
   105	: > "${TMP_DIR}/missing"
   106	while IFS= read -r p; do
   107	  [[ -n "$p" ]] || continue
   108	  [[ -e "${ROOT}/${p}" ]] || printf '%s\n' "$p" >> "${TMP_DIR}/missing"
   109	done < "${TMP_DIR}/both"
   110	
   111	entries=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/listed" | tr -d ' ')
   112	n_untracked=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" | tr -d ' ')
   113	n_missing=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/missing" | tr -d ' ')
   114	
   115	class_summary=""
   116	if [[ "$n_untracked" -gt 0 ]]; then
   117	  echo "check-manifest-paths: untracked manifest paths (not in git ls-files -- .claude), by class:" >&2
   118	  for cls in __pycache__ .pytest_cache node_modules .run .pyc .lock other; do
   119	    c=$(awk -F'\t' -v c="$cls" '$1 == c' "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
   120	    [[ "$c" -gt 0 ]] || continue
   121	    class_summary="${class_summary:+${class_summary}, }${cls}=${c}"
   122	    echo "  [${cls}] ${c} path(s):" >&2
   123	    awk -F'\t' -v c="$cls" '$1 == c { print "    " $2 }' "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" >&2
   124	  done
   125	fi
   126	if [[ "$n_missing" -gt 0 ]]; then
   127	  echo "check-manifest-paths: tracked manifest paths absent from the working tree:" >&2
   128	  sed 's/^/    /' "${TMP_DIR}/missing" >&2
   129	fi
   130	
   131	echo "manifest-paths: ${entries} entries, ${n_untracked} untracked${class_summary:+ (${class_summary})}, ${n_missing} missing"

   133	  echo "check-manifest-paths: FAIL — regenerate with: bash tools/gen-checksums.sh" >&2
   134	  exit 1
   135	fi
   136	exit 0
