1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.4, AC-1.3)
     4	#
     5	# Proves that a FRESH downstream submodule mount of this repository passes
     6	# `check-loa.sh` integrity: no Tampered, no Missing (paths the mount does not
     7	# link by design are reported as not-mounted and do not fail).
     8	#
     9	# Steps, all inside a new temp directory (nothing outside it is written):
    10	#   1. upstream/   — a `git clone` of this repository over file://, with a
    11	#                    local branch `fresh-mount-proof` at REF. With --worktree
    12	#                    the source work tree's uncommitted state (tracked edits,
    13	#                    deletions and untracked non-ignored files) is copied in
    14	#                    and committed on that branch, inside the temp clone only.
    15	#   2. downstream/ — `git init`, one commit, then the downstream entry point
    16	#                    `upstream/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh --branch
    17	#                    fresh-mount-proof --ref <sha> --force` with
    18	#                    LOA_UPSTREAM=file://.../upstream (the mount clones the
    19	#                    submodule from there; no network).
    20	#   3. `aleph.enabled: false` is set in downstream/.loa.config.yaml.
    21	#   4. `bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh` runs in downstream/; its full output
    22	#      is printed, then a summary line
    23	#        fresh-mount-proof: Tampered=T Missing=M not-mounted=N check-loa-rc=R
    24	#
    25	# Git runs hermetically: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1,
    26	# a fixed identity, protocol.file.allow=always (needed for a file:// submodule
    27	# on git >= 2.38.1) and core.hooksPath pointed at an empty directory.
    28	#
    29	# Usage:
    30	#   tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh [--ref REF] [--worktree] [--keep] [--tmp DIR]
    31	#
    32	# Options:
    33	#   --ref REF    commit-ish of this repository to mount (default: HEAD of the
    34	#                repository the script lives in)
    35	#   --worktree   mount REF plus the source work tree's uncommitted state
    36	#                (use before the change is committed)
    37	#   --keep       keep the temp directory and print its path
    38	#   --tmp DIR    parent directory for the temp directory (default: $TMPDIR or
    39	#                /tmp)
    40	#   -h, --help   this text
    41	#
    42	# Exit codes:
    43	#   0    check-loa.sh exited 0 on the fresh mount
    44	#   1    check-loa.sh exited non-zero (its output names the failures)
    45	#   2    usage error
    46	#   3    setup failed (clone, overlay, downstream init or the mount itself);
    47	#        the failing step's output is printed
    48	# =============================================================================
    49	set -euo pipefail
    50	export LC_ALL=C
    51	
    52	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    53	die2() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    54	die3() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: SETUP FAILED: $*" >&2; exit 3; }
    55	
    56	REF=""
    57	KEEP=0
    58	WORKTREE=0
    59	TMP_PARENT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --ref)
    63	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--ref requires a commit-ish"
    64	      REF="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    65	    --tmp)
    66	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--tmp requires a directory"
    67	      TMP_PARENT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    68	    --keep) KEEP=1; shift ;;
    69	    --worktree) WORKTREE=1; shift ;;
    70	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    71	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    72	  esac
    73	done
    74	[[ -d "$TMP_PARENT" ]] || die2 "--tmp is not a directory: $TMP_PARENT"
    75	
    76	SELF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)"
    77	SRC="$(git -C "$SELF_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "script is not inside a git work tree"
    78	[[ -n "$REF" ]] || REF="HEAD"
    79	REF_SHA="$(git -C "$SRC" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${REF}^{commit}")" || die2 "not a commit in $SRC: $REF"
    80	
    81	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMP_PARENT%/}/fresh-mount-proof.XXXXXX")"
    82	cleanup() {
    83	  if [[ $KEEP -eq 1 ]]; then
    84	    echo "fresh-mount-proof: kept $WORK" >&2
    85	  else
    86	    rm -rf "$WORK"
    87	  fi
    88	}
    89	trap cleanup EXIT
    90	
    91	# --- hermetic git ---------------------------------------------------------------
    92	mkdir -p "$WORK/no-hooks"
    93	export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
    94	export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=3
    95	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=protocol.file.allow GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=always
    96	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=core.hooksPath GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1="$WORK/no-hooks"
    97	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2=init.defaultBranch GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2=main
    98	export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="fresh-mount-proof" GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="fresh-mount-proof@localhost"
    99	export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME" GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL"
   100	unset LOA_ALEPH_ENABLED
   101	
   102	LOG="$WORK/step.log"
   103	run_step() {  # run_step <description> <cmd...>; output to $LOG, printed on failure
   104	  local desc="$1"; shift
   105	  if ! "$@" > "$LOG" 2>&1; then
   106	    cat "$LOG" >&2
   107	    die3 "$desc"
   108	  fi
   109	}
   110	
   111	suffix=""
   112	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && suffix=" + work-tree state"
   113	echo "fresh-mount-proof: source $SRC at ${REF_SHA}${suffix}"
   114	echo "fresh-mount-proof: temp dir $WORK"
   115	
   116	# --- 1. upstream clone ----------------------------------------------------------
   117	UP="$WORK/upstream"
   118	run_step "clone $SRC" git clone --quiet --no-checkout "file://$SRC" "$UP"
   119	run_step "fetch $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" fetch --quiet origin "$REF_SHA"
   120	run_step "branch at $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" checkout --quiet -B fresh-mount-proof "$REF_SHA"
   121	
   122	overlay() {
   123	  local p
   124	  while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
   125	    if [[ -e "$SRC/$p" || -L "$SRC/$p" ]]; then
   126	      [[ -d "$SRC/$p" && ! -L "$SRC/$p" ]] && continue   # gitlink / nested repo
   127	      mkdir -p "$UP/$(dirname "$p")"
   128	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   129	      cp -P "$SRC/$p" "$UP/$p"
   130	    else
   131	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   132	    fi
   133	  done < <(git -C "$SRC" ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard)
   134	  git -C "$UP" add -A
   135	  git -C "$UP" commit --quiet --allow-empty -m "fresh-mount-proof: work-tree state of $SRC"
   136	}
   137	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && run_step "work-tree overlay" overlay
   138	MOUNT_SHA="$(git -C "$UP" rev-parse HEAD)"
   139	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mounting upstream commit $MOUNT_SHA"
   140	
   141	# --- 2. downstream repository and the submodule mount --------------------------
   142	DOWN="$WORK/downstream"
   143	mkdir -p "$DOWN"
   144	init_downstream() {
   145	  git -C "$DOWN" init --quiet
   146	  printf '# downstream fixture\n' > "$DOWN/README.md"
   147	  git -C "$DOWN" add README.md
   148	  git -C "$DOWN" commit --quiet -m "initial commit"
   149	}
   150	run_step "downstream init" init_downstream
   151	
   152	do_mount() {
   153	  (cd "$DOWN" && LOA_UPSTREAM="file://$UP" bash "$UP/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh" \
   154	    --branch fresh-mount-proof --ref "$MOUNT_SHA" --force < /dev/null)
   155	}
   156	run_step "mount-submodule.sh" do_mount
   157	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mount-submodule.sh exited 0 ($(grep -c 'Linked' "$LOG" || true) link lines)"
   158	
   159	# --- 3. Aleph off ---------------------------------------------------------------
   160	CFG="$DOWN/.loa.config.yaml"
   161	[[ -f "$CFG" ]] || : > "$CFG"
   162	if command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   163	  run_step "aleph.enabled: false" yq -i '.aleph.enabled = false' "$CFG"
   164	else
   165	  printf '\naleph:\n  enabled: false\n' >> "$CFG"
   166	fi
   167	
   168	# --- 4. check-loa.sh ------------------------------------------------------------
   169	OUT="$WORK/check-loa.out"
   170	rc=0
   171	(cd "$DOWN" && CI=true bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh < /dev/null) > "$OUT" 2>&1 || rc=$?
   172	echo "----- check-loa.sh (downstream) -----"
   173	cat "$OUT"
   174	echo "----- end check-loa.sh (exit $rc) -----"
   175	
   176	tampered=$(grep -c 'Tampered: ' "$OUT" || true)
   177	missing=$(grep -c 'Missing: ' "$OUT" || true)
   178	not_mounted=$(sed -n 's/.*not-mounted: \([0-9][0-9]*\) path(s).*/\1/p' "$OUT")
   179	echo "fresh-mount-proof: Tampered=${tampered} Missing=${missing} not-mounted=${not_mounted:-0} check-loa-rc=${rc}"
   180	[[ $rc -eq 0 ]] && exit 0
   181	exit 1

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
     3	# =============================================================================
     4	# tests/unit/check-loa-mount-scope.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 1 (PRD FR-1 #1267,
     5	# AC-1.2/AC-1.3; SDD §5.3). check-loa.sh check_integrity classifies every
     6	# manifest path as ok, Tampered (fail), not-mounted (a submodule mount does
     7	# not link it but .loa/<path> has it: counted, one summary line, never a
     8	# failure) or Missing (fail).
     9	#
    10	# Seam: check-loa.sh already guards `main` behind
    11	#   [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "$0" ]]
    12	# so each case sources the script in a child bash inside the fixture
    13	# directory and calls check_integrity alone; the child exits 1 when the
    14	# FAILURES counter is non-zero, the same rule main applies. No other check
    15	# runs, and the script is not modified for the test.
    16	# =============================================================================
    17	
    18	setup() {
    19	  ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd -P)"
    20	  CHECK="$ROOT/.claude/scripts/check-loa.sh"
    21	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cloams.XXXXXX")"
    22	  D="$T/downstream"
    23	  # upstream tree inside the submodule path
    24	  mkdir -p "$D/.loa/.claude/lib" "$D/.claude"
    25	  printf 'echo a\n' > "$D/.loa/.claude/a.sh"
    26	  printf 'echo b\n' > "$D/.loa/.claude/b.sh"
    27	  printf 'echo c\n' > "$D/.loa/.claude/lib/c.sh"
    28	  # the mount links a.sh only (b.sh and lib/c.sh are not linked)
    29	  ln -s ../.loa/.claude/a.sh "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    30	  printf 'aleph:\n  enabled: false\n' > "$D/.loa.config.yaml"
    31	  source "$ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# fingerprint.sh — toolchain fingerprint for ablation runs (cycle-130 FR-4, SDD A11 / DEC-0389)
     4	#
     5	# Prints `fp:<sha256>` over the LC_ALL=C-sorted `tool=version` lines of the
     6	# toolchain an ablation run depends on (claude, codex, python3, node, yq, jq,
     7	# bats, git, docker) plus `source_tree=<HEAD of --source-tree>`. A tool that is
     8	# not installed reads `tool=absent`, so a missing tool changes the fingerprint
     9	# instead of failing the run. The value fills `image_digest` in host mode and
    10	# `fingerprint` in every mode (MANIFEST.json, pipeline.json, runs.jsonl). It reads the
    11	# HOST toolchain: in container mode the phases run on the image's toolchain, and the
    12	# image digest (not this value) identifies the batch's versions (on 2026-10-15 the host
    13	# CLI was 2.1.300 while Dockerfile.ablation pins 2.1.299).
    14	#
    15	# Usage:
    16	#   fingerprint.sh [--source-tree DIR] [--claude-bin B] [--bats-bin B] [--json]
    17	#
    18	# Options:
    19	#   --source-tree DIR  the pinned Loa tree; its `git rev-parse HEAD` is folded in
    20	#                      (`none` when absent or not a git tree)
    21	#   --claude-bin B     the CLI executable (default: $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
    22	#   --bats-bin B       bats executable (default: bats on PATH, else the operator's
    23	#                      ~/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats)
    24	#   --json             print {fingerprint, tools{}, source_tree, lines[]} instead
    25	#
    26	# Exit codes:
    27	#   0  printed
    28	#   2  usage error
    29	#
    30	# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (fingerprint cases).
    31	# =============================================================================
    32	set -euo pipefail
    33	export LC_ALL=C
    34	
    35	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
    36	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
    37	
    38	SOURCE_TREE=""
    39	CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
    40	BATS_BIN="${LOA_EVAL_BATS_BIN:-}"
    41	JSON=false
    42	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    43	  case "$1" in
    44	    --source-tree) SOURCE_TREE="${2:?--source-tree needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
    45	    --claude-bin)  CLAUDE_BIN="${2:?--claude-bin needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
    46	    --bats-bin)    BATS_BIN="${2:?--bats-bin needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
    47	    --json)        JSON=true; shift ;;
    48	    -h|--help)     sed -n '2,28p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    49	    *) echo "fingerprint.sh: unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    50	  esac
    51	done
    52	if [[ -z "$BATS_BIN" ]]; then
    53	  if command -v bats >/dev/null 2>&1; then BATS_BIN=bats
    54	  else BATS_BIN="$HOME/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats"; fi
    55	fi
    56	
    57	# first line of `<bin> <args>`, whitespace collapsed; `absent` when not runnable
    58	tool_version() {  # tool_version <bin> <args...>
    59	  local bin="$1"; shift
    60	  if ! command -v "$bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ ! -x "$bin" ]]; then printf 'absent'; return 0; fi
    61	  local out
    62	  out="$("$bin" "$@" 2>&1 < /dev/null || true)"
    63	  out="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n '1p' | tr -s ' \t' ' ' | sed 's/^ //; s/ $//')"
    64	  [[ -n "$out" ]] || out="unknown"
    65	  printf '%s' "$out"
    66	}
    67	
    68	lines="$(
    69	  {
    70	    printf 'claude=%s\n'  "$(tool_version "$CLAUDE_BIN" --version)"
    71	    printf 'codex=%s\n'   "$(tool_version codex --version)"
    72	    printf 'python3=%s\n' "$(tool_version python3 --version)"
    73	    printf 'node=%s\n'    "$(tool_version node --version)"
    74	    printf 'yq=%s\n'      "$(tool_version yq --version)"
    75	    printf 'jq=%s\n'      "$(tool_version jq --version)"
    76	    printf 'bats=%s\n'    "$(tool_version "$BATS_BIN" --version)"
    77	    printf 'git=%s\n'     "$(tool_version git --version)"
    78	    printf 'docker=%s\n'  "$(tool_version docker --version)"
    79	  } | LC_ALL=C sort
    80	)"
    81	src="none"
    82	if [[ -n "$SOURCE_TREE" ]]; then
    83	  src="$(git -C "$SOURCE_TREE" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo none)"
    84	fi
    85	lines="$lines"$'\n'"source_tree=$src"
    86	digest="$(printf '%s\n' "$lines" | python3 -I -c 'import hashlib, sys; print(hashlib.sha256(sys.stdin.buffer.read()).hexdigest())')"
    87	fp="fp:$digest"
    88	
    89	if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
    90	  printf '%s\n' "$lines" | jq -Rn --arg fp "$fp" --arg src "$src" '
    91	    [inputs | select(length > 0)] as $l
    92	    | {fingerprint: $fp, source_tree: $src, lines: $l,
    93	       tools: ($l | map(select(startswith("source_tree=") | not) | capture("^(?<k>[^=]+)=(?<v>.*)$") | {(.k): .v}) | add)}'
    94	else
    95	  printf '%s\n' "$fp"
    96	fi
    97	#!/usr/bin/env bash
    98	# =============================================================================
    99	# freeze.sh — cycle-130 ablation suite freeze (SDD §5.13, DEC-0404, DEC-0414)
   100	#
   101	# Writes or verifies <root>/MANIFEST.sha256, the suite's frozen identity: one
   102	# "<sha256>  <relpath>" line per file under <root>/tasks/ (and <root>/smoke/
   103	# with --smoke), relpath relative to the root, LC_ALL=C sorted, sha256 (Python
   104	# hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code, eval.yml trust boundary).
   105	# validate-suite.sh runs first; an invalid suite is never frozen or accepted.
   106	#
   107	# Usage:
   108	#   freeze.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--check] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
   109	#
   110	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0)
   111	#   --smoke           cover smoke/ too (passed to the validator as well)
   112	#   --check           recompute and compare with MANIFEST.sha256; write nothing
   113	#   --allow-partial   passed to validate-suite.sh (fewer than four tasks per type)
   114	#   --suite-file F    passed to validate-suite.sh
   115	#
   116	# Output: `freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 (N files, sha256 <digest of the manifest>)`
   117	# or `freeze: OK — N files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 …)`; on drift every
   118	# changed / added / removed path on its own line.
   119	#
   120	# Exit: 0 written / matches; 1 drift, missing manifest under --check, or the
   121	#       validator found violations; 2 usage.
   122	# Tested by evals/tests/freeze.bats.
   123	# =============================================================================
   124	set -euo pipefail
   125	export LC_ALL=C
   126	
   127	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
   128	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
   129	
   130	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
   131	CHECK=false SMOKE=false
   132	VARGS=()
   133	
   134	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,26p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
   135	die() { echo "freeze: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
   136	
   137	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
   138	  case "$1" in
   139	    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
   140	    --smoke) SMOKE=true; VARGS+=(--smoke); shift ;;
   141	    --check) CHECK=true; shift ;;
   142	    --allow-partial) VARGS+=(--allow-partial); shift ;;
   143	    --suite-file) [[ -n "${2:-}" ]] || die "--suite-file needs a path"; VARGS+=(--suite-file "$2"); shift 2 ;;
   144	    --help|-h) usage ;;
   145	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
   146	  esac
   147	done
   148	[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
   149	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
   150	MANIFEST="$ROOT/MANIFEST.sha256"
   151	
   152	vrc=0
   153	"$SCRIPT_DIR/validate-suite.sh" --root "$ROOT" ${VARGS[@]+"${VARGS[@]}"} || vrc=$?
   154	if [[ $vrc -eq 1 ]]; then echo "freeze: refused — the suite does not validate" >&2; exit 1; fi
   155	[[ $vrc -eq 0 ]] || die "validate-suite.sh failed (exit $vrc)"
   156	
   157	# compute_manifest <out> — the manifest body for the current tree.
   158	compute_manifest() {
   159	  local out="$1" list dirs=(tasks)
   160	  [[ "$SMOKE" == "true" ]] && dirs+=(smoke)
   161	  list="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze-list.XXXXXX")"
   162	  local d
   163	  for d in "${dirs[@]}"; do
   164	    [[ -d "$ROOT/$d" ]] || continue
   165	    ( cd "$ROOT" && find "$d" -type f -print )
   166	  done | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
   167	  if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then rm -f "$list"; die "a path under the suite holds a backslash"; fi
   168	  python3 -I - "$ROOT" "$list" > "$out" <<'PY' || { rm -f "$list"; die "hashing failed"; }
   169	import hashlib, os, sys
   170	root, listing = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   171	for rel in open(listing, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines():
   172	    if not rel:
   173	        continue
   174	    h = hashlib.sha256()
   175	    with open(os.path.join(root, rel), "rb") as f:
   176	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
   177	            h.update(b)
   178	    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + rel)
   179	PY
   180	  rm -f "$list"
   181	}
   182	digest_of() { python3 -I -c 'import hashlib, sys; print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()).hexdigest())' "$1"; }
   183	
   184	TMP="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze.XXXXXX")"
   185	trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT
   186	compute_manifest "$TMP"
   187	n="$(grep -c . "$TMP" || true)"
   188	
   189	if [[ "$CHECK" == "true" ]]; then
   190	  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || { echo "freeze: no MANIFEST.sha256 in $ROOT (run freeze.sh first)" >&2; exit 1; }
   191	  if cmp -s "$TMP" "$MANIFEST"; then
   192	    echo "freeze: OK — $n files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 $(digest_of "$MANIFEST"))"
   193	    exit 0
   194	  fi
   195	  echo "freeze: DRIFT against $MANIFEST:"
   196	  python3 -I - "$MANIFEST" "$TMP" <<'PY'
   197	import sys
   198	def load(p):
   199	    m = {}
   200	    for line in open(p, encoding="utf-8"):
   201	        line = line.rstrip("\n")
   202	        if line:
   203	            h, _, rel = line.partition("  ")
   204	            m[rel] = h
   205	    return m
   206	old, new = load(sys.argv[1]), load(sys.argv[2])
   207	for rel in sorted(set(old) | set(new)):
   208	    if rel not in new:

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# evals/tests/freeze.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.11 (PRD AC-5.1, sprint
     4	# AC-1.13, SDD §5.13, DEC-0414)
     5	#
     6	# freeze.sh writes MANIFEST.sha256 over every file under tasks/ (smoke/ with
     7	# --smoke) after validate-suite.sh passes; --check recomputes and fails on any
     8	# drift, one changed byte included, naming the path.
     9	# =============================================================================
    10	
    11	setup() {
    12	  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
    13	  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    14	  FZ="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/freeze.sh"
    15	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/fz.XXXXXX")"
    16	  R="$T/suite"; mkdir -p "$R"
    17	  export LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR="$T/no-prompts"
    18	  # shellcheck source=fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash
    19	  source "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash"
    20	  # shellcheck source=../../.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh
    21	  source "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
    22	  make_task "$R" tasks bug-fix-01 bug-fix
    23	  make_task "$R" tasks review-catch-01 review-catch
    24	}
    25	
    26	teardown() {
    27	  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
    28	  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
    29	}
    30	
    31	@test "FZ-1 freeze writes one sorted '<sha256>  <relpath>' line per file under tasks/; --check then passes" {
    32	  run "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial
    33	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    34	  grep -q '^freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 (' <<<"$output"
    35	  M="$R/MANIFEST.sha256"
    36	  [ "$(grep -c . "$M")" -eq "$(cd "$R" && find tasks -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" ]
    37	  [ "$(awk '{print $2}' "$M")" = "$(awk '{print $2}' "$M" | LC_ALL=C sort)" ]
    38	  ! grep -qv '^[0-9a-f]\{64\}  tasks/' "$M"
    39	  want="$(cd "$R" && sha256_portable tasks/bug-fix-01/task.yaml)"
    40	  grep -qxF "$want" "$M"
    41	  run "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial --check
    42	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    43	  grep -q '^freeze: OK — ' <<<"$output"
    44	}
    45	
    46	@test "FZ-2 one changed byte under tasks/ is drift: --check exits 1 and names the path; added and removed files too" {
    47	  "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial >/dev/null
    48	  f="$R/tasks/bug-fix-01/hidden/tests/test_slug.py"
    49	  printf 'X' | dd of="$f" bs=1 seek=0 count=1 conv=notrunc 2>/dev/null
    50	  run "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial --check
    51	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    52	  grep -q 'changed  tasks/bug-fix-01/hidden/tests/test_slug.py' <<<"$output"
    53	  "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial >/dev/null
    54	  echo extra > "$R/tasks/bug-fix-01/hidden/tests/extra.txt"
    55	  run "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial --check
    56	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    57	  grep -q 'added    tasks/bug-fix-01/hidden/tests/extra.txt' <<<"$output"
    58	  rm "$R/tasks/bug-fix-01/hidden/tests/extra.txt"
    59	  "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial >/dev/null
    60	  rm "$R/tasks/bug-fix-01/hidden/reference.patch"
    61	  yq -i '.reference_patch = null | .type = "refactor" | .structural_check = "hidden/tests/test_slug.py"' "$R/tasks/bug-fix-01/task.yaml"
    62	  run "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial --check
    63	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    64	  grep -q 'removed  tasks/bug-fix-01/hidden/reference.patch' <<<"$output"
    65	  grep -q 'changed  tasks/bug-fix-01/task.yaml' <<<"$output"
    66	}
    67	
    68	@test "FZ-3 an invalid suite is never frozen: exit 1, no manifest written" {
    69	  echo "uses hidden tests" >> "$R/tasks/bug-fix-01/TASK.md"
    70	  run "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial
    71	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    72	  grep -q 'refused — the suite does not validate' <<<"$output"
    73	  [ ! -e "$R/MANIFEST.sha256" ]
    74	}
    75	
    76	@test "FZ-4 --smoke covers smoke/; without it smoke files are outside the manifest" {
    77	  make_task "$R" smoke smoke-x bug-fix
    78	  "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial >/dev/null
    79	  ! grep -q '  smoke/' "$R/MANIFEST.sha256"

content.content:
1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# validate-suite.sh — cycle-130 ablation task-suite validator (SDD §3.2, DEC-0424)
     4	#
     5	# Checks every task of the ablation-2.0 suite before it is frozen, run or graded.
     6	#
     7	# Usage:
     8	#   validate-suite.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
     9	#
    10	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0); the
    11	#                     tasks are <root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml
    12	#   --smoke           also validate <root>/smoke/<id>/task.yaml (never counted)
    13	#   --allow-partial   skip the four-by-four type count (Sprint 258 state)
    14	#   --suite-file F    suite yaml (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml): arm ids
    15	#                     for the leakage check, arms' task_types, suite_version
    16	#
    17	# Checks (each violation is one stdout line `<task-id>: <reason>`):
    18	#   1. schema: id (= directory name), schema_version 1, type (feature-build |
    19	#      bug-fix | refactor | review-catch), source {kind, date, fix_commit?,
    20	#      base_commit?, bead?, origin?}, post_cutoff (bool), fixture (dir under the
    21	#      root; null only for review-catch), criterion (agent-facing; no path, file
    22	#      name or test name), success_criterion, test_command (array; null only for
    23	#      review-catch), regression_command (array | null), reference_patch (hidden/…
    24	#      | null; required for bug-fix and feature-build), grader_protected (array of
    25	#      relative paths present in the fixture), structural_check (hidden/… | null;
    26	#      required for refactor), bounds {max_turns{}, timeout_min{}} (phase → positive
    27	#      int), review_catch (null, or {fixture, manifest, labels?} for review-catch,
    28	#      both present), suite_version (= the suite file's), TASK.md present
    29	#   2. counts: four tasks of each type under tasks/ (unless --allow-partial)
    30	#   3. allowlist: test_command[0] and regression_command[0] in python3 | pytest |
    31	#      bats | bash | node | npx
    32	#   4. hidden/manifest.json (build types): {"files": [{src, dest}]}; every src
    33	#      exists under hidden/; every dest is relative, inside the tree, no `..`
    34	#   5. fixture path rule (build types): check_fixture_path_rule from
    35	#      lib/sandbox-mount.sh — no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires/
    36	#      or .run/ at the fixture's top level; the reference patch touches none either
    37	#   6. leakage: TASK.md and criterion (the task-brief text is built from these)
    38	#      and every phase prompt under evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts/ contain none
    39	#      of: the string `hidden` (any case), a hidden test file's stem, a defect id
    40	#      of the review manifest, a `D[0-9]{2}-` key, an arm id of the suite file
    41	#   7. suite file: every non-absent arm's task_types are known (all | build |
    42	#      review-catch | feature-build | bug-fix | refactor)
    43	#
    44	# Exit: 0 valid; 1 violations (every one listed); 2 usage / unreadable input.
    45	# Tested by evals/tests/validate-suite.bats.
    46	# =============================================================================
    47	set -euo pipefail
    48	export LC_ALL=C
    49	
    50	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    51	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    52	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
    53	SUITE_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    54	PROMPTS_DIR="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts}"
    55	SMOKE=false ALLOW_PARTIAL=false
    56	
    57	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,45p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    58	die() { echo "validate-suite: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    59	
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    63	    --smoke) SMOKE=true; shift ;;
    64	    --allow-partial) ALLOW_PARTIAL=true; shift ;;
    65	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    66	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    67	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    68	  esac
    69	done
    70	[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
    71	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
    72	[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
    73	for tool in yq jq python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: $tool"; done
    74	# eval.yml trust boundary: a literal in-tree path, no variable on the source line
    75	pushd "$SCRIPT_DIR" >/dev/null
    76	# shellcheck source=lib/sandbox-mount.sh
    77	source ./lib/sandbox-mount.sh
    78	popd >/dev/null
    79	
    80	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/validate-suite.XXXXXX")"
    81	trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
    82	yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE" > "$WORK/suite.json" 2>/dev/null || die "suite file is not valid YAML: $SUITE_FILE"
    83	
    84	# Collect task directories: tasks/* (counted) and smoke/* (with --smoke).
    85	: > "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
    86	for group in tasks smoke; do
    87	  [[ "$group" == "smoke" && "$SMOKE" != "true" ]] && continue
    88	  [[ -d "$ROOT/$group" ]] || continue
    89	  for d in "$ROOT/$group"/*/; do
    90	    [[ -d "$d" ]] || continue
    91	    d="${d%/}"
    92	    n="$(basename "$d")"
    93	    j="$WORK/$group.$n.json"
    94	    if [[ ! -f "$d/task.yaml" ]]; then
    95	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "-" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"; continue
    96	    fi
    97	    if yq -o=json '.' "$d/task.yaml" > "$j" 2>/dev/null && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$j" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    98	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "$j" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
    99	    else
   100	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "!" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
   101	    fi
   102	  done
   103	done
   104	
   105	# Python does the schema, counts, allowlist, manifest, leakage and suite checks;
   106	# it prints violations, and `FIXTURE\t<id>\t<dir>` lines for the path rule below.

     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# spend.sh — cycle-130 cycle spend (SDD §5.11, PRD FR-2, DEC-0363)
     4	#
     5	# Prints what the cycle has spent: the run rows' cost_usd plus the operator
     6	# cost ledger's cost_micro_usd since the kickoff timestamp, against the cap.
     7	#
     8	# Usage:
     9	#   spend.sh [--since TS] [--runs FILE…] [--ledger FILE] [--cap USD]
    10	#            [--reserve USD] [--json]
    11	#
    12	#   --since TS     ledger rows with ts >= TS count (default 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z,
    13	#                  the cycle-130 kickoff); run rows are the cycle's own and all count
    14	#   --runs FILE…   run-row files (JSONL, `cost_usd` per row); repeatable, and every
    15	#                  following non-option argument is a file too. Default:
    16	#                  grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl plus every
    17	#                  evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl that exists. A row whose
    18	#                  run_id was already counted from another file is counted once.
    19	#   --ledger FILE  cost ledger (JSONL, `ts`, `cost_micro_usd`; default .run/cost-ledger.jsonl)
    20	#   --cap USD      cycle cap (default: evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
    21	#                  else caps.cycle_usd in evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml, else 1500)
    22	#   --reserve USD  reserve (default caps.reserve_usd in the suite file, else 250)
    23	#   --json         one JSON object: total_usd, runs_usd, ledger_usd, since, cap_usd,
    24	#                  headroom_usd, reserve_usd, runs_files, ledger_file, runs_rows,
    25	#                  runs_rows_deduped, ledger_rows, skipped_lines
    26	#
    27	# Output: cycle spend USD T (runs R + ledger L since S); cap C; headroom H; reserve V
    28	#   headroom = cap - total (negative when over). Default files that do not exist
    29	#   count as zero; a malformed line is skipped and counted (stderr note).
    30	#
    31	# Exit: 0 printed; 1 a named file (or an existing default) is unreadable; 2 usage.
    32	# Tested by evals/tests/spend.bats.
    33	# =============================================================================
    34	set -euo pipefail
    35	export LC_ALL=C
    36	
    37	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    38	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    39	SINCE="2026-10-14T13:50:00Z"
    40	LEDGER="" CAP="" RESERVE="" JSON=false
    41	RUNS=()
    42	
    43	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,32p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    44	die() { echo "spend: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    45	num_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; }
    46	
    47	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    48	  case "$1" in
    49	    --since) SINCE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    50	    --runs)
    51	      [[ -n "${2:-}" && "${2:-}" != --* ]] || die "--runs needs at least one file"
    52	      shift
    53	      while [[ $# -gt 0 && "$1" != --* ]]; do RUNS+=("$1"); shift; done ;;
    54	    --ledger) LEDGER="${2:-}"; [[ -n "$LEDGER" ]] || die "--ledger needs a file"; shift 2 ;;
    55	    --cap) CAP="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    56	    --reserve) RESERVE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    57	    --json) JSON=true; shift ;;
    58	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    59	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    60	  esac
    61	done
    62	[[ "$SINCE" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?)?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})?)?$ ]] \
    63	  || die "--since must be an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z)"
    64	command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: python3"

    66	SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    67	yq_num() {  # yq_num <expr> <file> — a number or empty
    68	  local v
    69	  [[ -f "$2" ]] && command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0

    71	  num_ok "$v" && printf '%s' "$v"
    72	  return 0
    73	}
    74	if [[ -z "$CAP" ]]; then
    75	  CAP="$(yq_num '.evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml")"
    76	  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP="$(yq_num '.caps.cycle_usd' "$SUITE")"
    77	  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP=1500
    78	fi
    79	if [[ -z "$RESERVE" ]]; then
    80	  RESERVE="$(yq_num '.caps.reserve_usd' "$SUITE")"
    81	  [[ -n "$RESERVE" ]] || RESERVE=250
    82	fi
    83	num_ok "$CAP" || die "--cap must be a non-negative number"
    84	num_ok "$RESERVE" || die "--reserve must be a non-negative number"
    85	
    86	# Explicit files must be readable; defaults are optional (absent = zero).
    87	if [[ ${#RUNS[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    88	  [[ -e "$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl" ]] && RUNS+=("$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl")
    89	  for f in "$REPO_ROOT"/evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl; do [[ -e "$f" ]] && RUNS+=("$f"); done
    90	fi
    91	EXPLICIT_LEDGER=true
    92	if [[ -z "$LEDGER" ]]; then
    93	  EXPLICIT_LEDGER=false
    94	  LEDGER="$REPO_ROOT/.run/cost-ledger.jsonl"
    95	fi
    96	for f in ${RUNS[@]+"${RUNS[@]}"}; do
    97	  [[ -f "$f" && -r "$f" ]] || { echo "spend: run-row file unreadable: $f" >&2; exit 1; }
    98	done
    99	if [[ -e "$LEDGER" || "$EXPLICIT_LEDGER" == "true" ]]; then
   100	  [[ -f "$LEDGER" && -r "$LEDGER" ]] || { echo "spend: ledger unreadable: $LEDGER" >&2; exit 1; }
   101	else
   102	  LEDGER=""
   103	fi
   104	
   105	python3 -I - "$SINCE" "$CAP" "$RESERVE" "$JSON" "$LEDGER" ${RUNS[@]+"${RUNS[@]}"} <<'PY'
   106	import json, sys
   107	from datetime import datetime, timezone
   108	
   109	since_s, cap, reserve, as_json, ledger = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4] == "true", sys.argv[5]
   110	runs_files = sys.argv[6:]
   111	
   112	def ts(s):
   113	    s = s.strip()
   114	    if len(s) == 10:
   115	        s += "T00:00:00Z"
   116	    d = datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
   117	    return d if d.tzinfo else d.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
   118	
   119	since = ts(since_s)
   120	skipped = 0
   121	runs_usd, runs_rows, dedup = 0.0, 0, 0
   122	seen = set()
   123	for f in runs_files:
   124	    for line in open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
   125	        if not line.strip():
   126	            continue
   127	        try:
   128	            r = json.loads(line)
   129	            c = float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0)
   130	        except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
   131	            skipped += 1
   132	            continue
   133	        rid = r.get("run_id")
   134	        key = rid if isinstance(rid, str) and rid else None
   135	        if key is not None and key in seen:
   136	            dedup += 1
   137	            continue
   138	        if key is not None:
   139	            seen.add(key)
   140	        runs_usd += c
   141	        runs_rows += 1
   142	
   143	ledger_usd, ledger_rows = 0.0, 0
   144	if ledger:
   145	    for line in open(ledger, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
   146	        if not line.strip():
   147	            continue
   148	        try:
   149	            r = json.loads(line)
   150	            if ts(str(r["ts"])) < since:
   151	                continue
   152	            ledger_usd += float(r.get("cost_micro_usd") or 0) / 1e6
   153	            ledger_rows += 1
   154	        except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
   155	            skipped += 1
   156	
   157	total = runs_usd + ledger_usd
   158	headroom = cap - total
   159	if skipped:
   160	    print(f"spend: skipped {skipped} malformed line(s)", file=sys.stderr)
   161	def n(x):
   162	    x = round(x, 4)
   163	    return int(x) if x == int(x) else x
   164	if as_json:
   165	    print(json.dumps({
   166	        "total_usd": n(total), "runs_usd": n(runs_usd), "ledger_usd": n(ledger_usd),
   167	        "since": since_s, "cap_usd": n(cap), "headroom_usd": n(headroom), "reserve_usd": n(reserve),
   168	        "runs_files": runs_files, "ledger_file": ledger or None, "runs_rows": runs_rows,
   169	        "runs_rows_deduped": dedup, "ledger_rows": ledger_rows, "skipped_lines": skipped}, sort_keys=True))
   170	else:
   171	    def money(x): return f"{x:,.2f}"
   172	    def whole(x): return f"{x:,.0f}" if x == int(x) else f"{x:,.2f}"
   173	    print(f"cycle spend USD {money(total)} (runs {money(runs_usd)} + ledger {money(ledger_usd)} since {since_s}); "
   174	          f"cap {whole(cap)}; headroom {money(headroom)}; reserve {whole(reserve)}")
   175	PY

    62	     phases: [IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX],

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# evals/tests/validate-suite.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.11 (DEC-0424,

     8	# four-by-four counts (relaxed by --allow-partial), the test_command allowlist,
     9	# hidden/manifest.json destinations, the fixture path rule, leakage strings in
    10	# TASK.md / criterion / phase prompts, the suite file's task_types.

    13	setup() {

content.content: #!/usr/bin/env bash # claude-stub-pipeline.sh — stand-in for the `claude` CLI in evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats. # One invocation = one pipeline phase. The phase is read from the prompt's first # line (`# Phase: `); the stub records what the executor gave it and emits a # stream-json transcript with a system/init event (session_id), per-turn # assistant events carrying usage, and a result event. # STUB_LOG_DIR per call: call-.argv (NUL-separated), call-.env # (`env` output), call-.fds (ls /proc/self/fd), call-.phase, # call-.pwd. The executor's `env -i` strips these # controls, so tests reach the stub through a wrapper that # records pending.env / pending.fds and then loads them. # STUB_COST_ result total_cost_usd (default 0.5) # STUB_TURNS_ assistant turns to emit (default 2) # STUB_TURN_OUT_ output tokens per turn (default 100) # STUB_TURN_SLEEP seconds between turns (default 0) # STUB_SLEEP_ seconds to sleep before the result event # STUB_EXIT_ exit code (default 0) # STUB_SELF_KILL_ 1: SIGTERM itself mid-phase (a phase killed from outside) # STUB_VERDICT_REVIEW / STUB_VERDICT_AUDIT APPROVED (default) | CHANGES_REQUIRED # STUB_MODEL_USED_ model id reported in modelUsage (default: --model) # STUB_REFUSAL_ 1: emit a system/model_refusal_fallback event # STUB_DOT_CLAUDE_WRITE_ 1: emit a Write tool_use under .claude/ # STUB_LEDGER_USD_ append a cost-ledger row of that many USD to # $LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH and one MODELINV row to # $LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH (a cheval voice call); the row's # calling_primitive / effort / effort_effective come from # STUB_PRIMITIVE_, STUB_HOP_EFFORT_, # STUB_HOP_EFFECTIVE_ set -euo pipefail if [[ "${1:-}" == "--version" ]]; then echo "2.1.299 (Claude Code) stub"; exit 0; fi prompt="" model="" resume="" args=("$@") i=0 while [[ $i -lt ${#args[@]} ]]; do case "${args[$i]}" in -p) prompt="${args[$((i + 1))]}"; i=$((i + 1)) ;; --model) model="${args[$((i + 1))]}"; i=$((i + 1)) ;; --resume) resume="${args[$((i + 1))]}"; i=$((i + 1)) ;; esac i=$((i + 1)) done phase="$(printf '%s\n' "$prompt" | sed -n '1s/^# Phase: //p')" [[ -n "$phase" ]] || phase=UNKNOWN if [[ -n "${STUB_LOG_DIR:-}" ]]; then mkdir -p "$STUB_LOG_DIR" n=1; while [[ -e "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.argv" ]]; do n=$((n + 1)); done printf '%s\0' "$@" > "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.argv" # the executor runs the CLI under `env -i`, so the bats wrapper (make_wrappers in # pipeline-run.bats) captures the environment and descriptors it was given into # pending.* BEFORE loading the stub's controls; without a wrapper, capture here if [[ -f "$STUB_LOG_DIR/pending.env" ]]; then mv "$STUB_LOG_DIR/pending.env" "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.env" else env | sed -E 's/^(AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK)=.*/\1=/' > "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.env"; fi # key name only if [[ -f "$STUB_LOG_DIR/pending.fds" ]]; then mv "$STUB_LOG_DIR/pending.fds" "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.fds" else ls "/proc/$$/fd" > "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.fds" 2>/dev/null || true; fi printf '%s\n' "$phase" > "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.phase" printf '%s\n' "$PWD" > "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.pwd" fi v() { local k="$1_$phase" d="$2"; printf '%s' "${!k:-$d}"; } cost="$(v STUB_COST 0.5)"; turns="$(v STUB_TURNS 2)"; out_tok="$(v STUB_TURN_OUT 100)" used="$(v STUB_MODEL_USED "$model")" if [[ -n "$resume" ]]; then sid="$resume"; else sid="sess-$phase-$$-$RANDOM"; fi a2a="grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1" case "$phase" in PLAN) mkdir -p grimoires/loa; printf '# Sprint plan\n\n## Success Criteria\nx\n' > grimoires/loa/sprint.md ;; IMPLEMENT|FIX) printf '%s\n' "$phase" >> work.txt; mkdir -p "$a2a"; printf 'report %s\n' "$phase" > "$a2a/reviewer.md" ;; BARE) printf '%s\n' "$phase" >> work.txt ;; REVIEW|AUDIT) if [[ "$phase" == REVIEW ]]; then vv="${STUB_VERDICT_REVIEW:-APPROVED}" f="$a2a/engineer-feedback.md" gate=review t=code_review else vv="${STUB_VERDICT_AUDIT:-APPROVED}" f="$a2a/auditor-sprint-feedback.md" gate=audit t=security_audit; fi mkdir -p "$a2a" printf 'feedback\n\n' "$gate" "$vv" > "$f" # the dissent envelope says what the sandbox config planned (A3 evidence) cv="$(yq -r ".flatline_protocol.$t.companion_voice" .loa.config.yaml 2>/dev/null || echo null)" planned=true; [[ "$cv" == false ]] && planned=false jq -n --argjson p "$planned" '{verdict_quality: {status: "APPROVED", voices_planned: (if $p then 2 else 1 end), voices_succeeded: (if $p then 2 else 1 end)}, metadata: {companion_voice: {planned: $p}}}' \ > "$a2a/adversarial-$gate.json" ;; esac led="$(v STUB_LEDGER_USD 0)" if [[ "$led" != 0 && -n "${LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH:-}" ]]; then jq -cn --argjson u "$led" '{ts: "2026-10-15T00:00:00Z", agent: "flatline-orchestrator", cost_micro_usd: ($u * 1000000 | round)}' >> "$LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH" prim_d="adversarial-$(printf '%s' "$phase" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')" prim="$(v STUB_PRIMITIVE "$prim_d")"; heff="$(v STUB_HOP_EFFORT xhigh)"; heffv="$(v STUB_HOP_EFFECTIVE "$heff")" jq -cn --arg p "$prim" --arg e "$heff" --arg ee "$heffv" --argjson u "$led" \ '{schema_version: "1.1.0", primitive_id: "MODELINV", event_type: "model.invoke.complete", ts_utc: "2026-10-15T00:00:00.000000Z", payload: {models_requested: ["openai:gpt-5.5"], models_succeeded: ["openai:gpt-5.5"], calling_primitive: $p, effort: $e, effort_effective: $ee, cost_micro_usd: ($u * 1000000 | round)}}' >> "${LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH:-/dev/null}" fi printf '{"type":"system","subtype":"init","session_id":"%s","model":"%s"}\n' "$sid" "$model" if [[ "$(v STUB_REFUSAL 0)" == 1 ]]; then printf '{"type":"system","subtype":"model_refusal_fallback","original_model":"%s","fallback_model":"other-model","api_refusal_category":"x"}\n' "$model" fi if [[ "$(v STUB_DOT_CLAUDE_WRITE 0)" == 1 ]]; then printf '{"type":"assistant","message":{"id":"msg-w","content":[{"type":"tool_use","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":".claude/skills/x/SKILL.md","content":"x"}}],"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":1}}}\n' fi t=1 while [[ $t -le $turns ]]; do printf '{"type":"assistant","message":{"id":"msg-%s-%d","content":[{"type":"text","text":"turn %d"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":10,"output_tokens":%d,"cache_read_input_tokens":0,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0}}}\n' \ "$phase" "$t" "$t" "$out_tok" if [[ "$(v STUB_SELF_KILL 0)" == 1 && $t -eq 1 ]]; then kill -TERM $$; sleep 5; fi [[ "${STUB_TURN_SLEEP:-0}" != 0 ]] && sleep "$STUB_TURN_SLEEP" t=$((t + 1)) done s="$(v STUB_SLEEP 0)"; [[ "$s" != 0 ]] && sleep "$s" printf '{"type":"result","subtype":"success","is_error":false,"session_id":"%s","duration_ms":1000,"num_turns":%d,"total_cost_usd":%s,"usage":{"input_tokens":%d,"output_tokens":%d,"cache_read_input_tokens":3,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4},"modelUsage":{"%s":{"inputTokens":%d,"outputTokens":%d,"costUSD":%s}}}\n' \ "$sid" "$turns" "$cost" $((turns * 10)) $((turns * out_tok)) "$used" $((turns * 10)) $((turns * out_tok)) "$cost" exit "$(v STUB_EXIT 0)" #!/usr/bin/env bash # docker-stub.sh — stand-in for the docker 26.1 CLI in evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats. # docker image inspect --format … prints $DOCKER_STUB_IMAGE_ID (default # sha256:feedface…); exit 1 when # DOCKER_STUB_NO_IMAGE=1 # docker kill … records and exits 0 # (each -v spec and, for the non-/workspace mounts, every path under its source go # to $DOCKER_STUB_LOG/run-.mounts) # docker run records argv (NUL-separated) to # $DOCKER_STUB_LOG/run-.argv, then runs # on the host: /workspace in args and # env values maps to the -v source of # every mount (/workspace, /home/evaluser), # the environment is exactly the -e set # (bare `-e KEY` takes the client's value), # the command word `claude` maps to # $DOCKER_STUB_CLAUDE set -euo pipefail log="${DOCKER_STUB_LOG:-/dev/null}" case "${1:-}" in --version) echo "Docker version 26.1.5 (stub)"; exit 0 ;; image) [[ "${DOCKER_STUB_NO_IMAGE:-0}" == 1 ]] && { echo "Error: No such image" >&2; exit 1; } echo "${DOCKER_STUB_IMAGE_ID:-sha256:feedfacefeedfacefeedfacefeedfacefeedfacefeedfacefeedfacefeedface}"; exit 0 ;; kill) [[ "$log" != /dev/null ]] && printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "$log/kill.log"; exit 0 ;; run) shift ;; *) echo "docker-stub: unsupported: $*" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac if [[ "$log" != /dev/null ]]; then mkdir -p "$log"; n=1; while [[ -e "$log/run-$n.argv" ]]; do n=$((n + 1)); done printf '%s\0' run "$@" > "$log/run-$n.argv" fi ws="" wd="/" mounts=() envs=() # flags that take a value (docker 26.1 run); everything else before the image is boolean while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do case "$1" in -v|--volume) src="${2%%:*}" rest="${2#*:}"; dst="${rest%%:*}"; [[ "$dst" == /workspace ]] && ws="$src" mounts+=("$dst=$src") # record each mount and, for the non-/workspace mounts, every path under its source if [[ "$log" != /dev/null ]]; then { printf '%s\n' "$2" if [[ "$dst" != /workspace ]]; then (cd "$src" && find . -mindepth 1 | sed 's|^\./| |' | LC_ALL=C sort); fi } >> "$log/run-$n.mounts" fi shift 2 ;; -e|--env) # KEY=value as given; a bare KEY takes the client's own value (how secrets travel) if [[ "$2" == *=* ]]; then envs+=("$2"); elif [[ -n "${!2+x}" ]]; then envs+=("$2=${!2}"); fi shift 2 ;; -w|--workdir) wd="$2"; shift 2 ;; --name|--user|--network|--tmpfs|--pids-limit|--memory|--cpus) shift 2 ;; --rm|--read-only|-i|-t) shift ;; -*) echo "docker-stub: unknown flag $1" >&2; exit 2 ;; *) break ;; esac done shift # the image [[ -n "$ws" ]] || { echo "docker-stub: no /workspace mount" >&2; exit 2; } map() { # container path → host path, for every mount local s="$1" m dst src for m in "${mounts[@]}"; do dst="${m%%=*}" src="${m#*=}"; s="${s//$dst/$src}"; done printf '%s' "$s" } cmd=() menv=() for a in "$@"; do a="$(map "$a")" [[ "$a" == claude ]] && a="${DOCKER_STUB_CLAUDE:?DOCKER_STUB_CLAUDE unset}" cmd+=("$a") done for e in ${envs[@]+"${envs[@]}"}; do menv+=("${e%%=*}=$(map "${e#*=}")"); done cd "$(map "$wd")" # the container's environment is exactly the -e set (plus nothing from this host) exec env -i ${menv[@]+"${menv[@]}"} "${cmd[@]}" #!/usr/bin/env bash # mount-lib-stub.sh — test stand-in for implementer B's evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh # (cycle-130 Sprint 258). pipeline-run.sh sources lib/sandbox-mount.sh by a literal # path; pipeline-run.bats (make_harness) and ablation-runs/regen.sh run a temporary # copy of the harness with THIS file in that place. Same function names, signatures # and return codes as B's contract (0 ok, 2 refused); evidence `key=value` lines go # to stdout (the driver appends them to $ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE); the gates toggle writes # LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false to $ARM_ENV_FILE as B's library does. The # behaviour is deliberately small: copy the prompt tree's .claude/, CLAUDE.md and # .loa.config.yaml; apply the toggles the tests check; hash .claude/ with hashlib. # STUB_MOUNT_FAIL= make that function return 2 (infrastructure path) # STUB_BRIEF_EXTRA= appended to task-brief.md (leak-guard cases) # STUB_ARM_ENV_EXTRA= an extra line written to $ARM_ENV_FILE (env filter case) _stub_fail() { [[ "${STUB_MOUNT_FAIL:-}" == "$1" ]] && { echo "stub: $1 refused" >&2; return 0; }; return 1; } mount_prompt_surface() { # _stub_fail mount_prompt_surface && return 2 local ws="$1" tree="$2" [[ -d "$tree/.claude" ]] || { echo "stub: no .claude in $tree" >&2; return 2; } cp -a "$tree/.claude" "$ws/.claude" printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md" [[ -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]] && cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" echo "mount=whole_tree" } resolve_arm_toggles() { # _stub_fail resolve_arm_toggles && return 2 local def def="$(ARM="$1" yq -o=json '.arms[] | select(.id == env(ARM))' "$2" 2>/dev/null)" [[ -n "$def" ]] || { echo "stub: arm $1 undeclared" >&2; return 2; } [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$def")" == true ]] && { echo "stub: arm $1 absent" >&2; return 2; } jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$def" } apply_arm_toggles() { # _stub_fail apply_arm_toggles && return 2 local ws="$1" tg="$2" cfg="$1/.loa.config.yaml" f n=0 e if [[ "$(jq -r '.companion_voice' <<<"$tg")" == false ]]; then yq -i '.flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice = false | .flatline_protocol.security_audit.companion_voice = false' "$cfg" echo "companion_voice=false" fi if [[ "$(jq -r '.gates' <<<"$tg")" == false ]]; then yq -i '.flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled = false | .flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled = false' "$cfg" echo "gates=false"; echo "arm_env=LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false" [[ -n "${ARM_ENV_FILE:-}" ]] && echo "LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false" >> "$ARM_ENV_FILE" fi if [[ "$(jq -r '.flatline' <<<"$tg")" == false ]]; then yq -i '.flatline_protocol.enabled = false' "$cfg"; echo "flatline=false" fi e="$(jq -r '.effort // empty' <<<"$tg")" if [[ -n "$e" ]]; then for f in "$ws"/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue # frontmatter only (between the first two --- lines), as B's library does awk 'NR == 1 {fm = ($0 == "---")} NR > 1 && fm && $0 == "---" {fm = 0; print; next} fm && NR > 1 && /^effort:/ {next} {print}' \ "$f" > "$f.tmp" && mv "$f.tmp" "$f"; n=$((n + 1)) done echo "effort=$e"; echo "effort_stripped=$n" fi [[ "$(jq -r '.loa_mount' <<<"$tg")" == false ]] && echo "loa_mount=none" [[ -n "${STUB_ARM_ENV_EXTRA:-}" && -n "${ARM_ENV_FILE:-}" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$STUB_ARM_ENV_EXTRA" >> "$ARM_ENV_FILE" return 0 } regen_sandbox_manifest() { # _stub_fail regen_sandbox_manifest && return 2 python3 -I -c ' import hashlib, json, os, sys ws = sys.argv[1] files = {} for d, _, names in os.walk(os.path.join(ws, ".claude")): for n in names: p = os.path.join(d, n); rel = os.path.relpath(p, ws) if rel == ".claude/checksums.json" or rel.startswith(".claude/overrides/"): continue files[rel] = hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest() man = os.path.join(ws, ".claude", "checksums.json") with open(man, "w") as f: json.dump({"generated": "stub", "algorithm": "sha256", "files": dict(sorted(files.items()))}, f, indent=2) print("manifest_files=%d" % len(files)) print("manifest_sha256=" + hashlib.sha256(open(man, "rb").read()).hexdigest())' "$1" } check_fixture_path_rule() { # _stub_fail check_fixture_path_rule && return 2 local d="$1" p bad=0 for p in .claude CLAUDE.md .loa.config.yaml grimoires .run; do [[ -e "$d/$p" ]] && { echo "fixture path rule: $p" >&2; bad=1; } done [[ $bad -eq 0 ]] || return 2 return 0 } write_sandbox_grimoire() { # _stub_fail write_sandbox_grimoire && return 2 local ws="$1" ty="$2" arm="$3" sp="$4" g="$1/grimoires/loa" type mkdir -p "$g/context" "$g/a2a/$sp" printf '{"cycles":[{"id":"cycle-eval","status":"active","sprints":[{"local":"%s","status":"planned"}]}]}\n' "$sp" > "$g/ledger.json" printf '# NOTES\n' > "$g/NOTES.md" { printf '# Task brief\n\n%s\n' "$(yq -r '.criterion // ""' "$ty")" [[ -f "$(dirname "$ty")/TASK.md" ]] && cat "$(dirname "$ty")/TASK.md" [[ -n "${STUB_BRIEF_EXTRA:-}" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$STUB_BRIEF_EXTRA" } > "$g/context/task-brief.md" type="$(yq -r '.type' "$ty")" if [[ "$type" == review-catch ]]; 1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
2	# =============================================================================
3	# evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 258 Tasks 1.7 + 1.12
4	# (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6; sprint.md AC-1.7, AC-1.12, AC-1.14; PRD AC-4.x)
5	#
6	# evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh drives Loa's phases as separate CLI sessions in a
7	# sandbox repository. Here the CLI is evals/tests/fixtures/claude-stub-pipeline.sh,
8	# docker is fixtures/docker-stub.sh, and the executor runs from a temporary copy of
9	# the harness (make_harness) whose lib/sandbox-mount.sh is fixtures/mount-lib-stub.sh:
10	# the shipped script sources its library by a literal path only (eval.yml trust
11	# boundary), so there is no environment override to point. The executor runs the CLI under
12	# `env -i`, which strips the stubs' control variables, so each test reaches the
13	# stubs through generated wrappers ($T/claude, $T/docker) that first record the
14	# environment and descriptors the executor gave them, then load $T/stub.env.
15	# =============================================================================
16	
17	setup() {
18	  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
19	  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
20	  FP="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/fingerprint.sh"
21	  STUB="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/claude-stub-pipeline.sh"
22	  DSTUB="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/docker-stub.sh"
23	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/pr.XXXXXX")"
24	  export LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S=0.1
25	  export LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON='{"global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5":{"input_per_mtok":4000000,"output_per_mtok":20000000},"global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1":{"input_per_mtok":10000000,"output_per_mtok":50000000}}'
26	  export LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME="$T/home"
27	  : > "$T/stub.env"
28	  make_harness
29	  make_source_tree
30	  cp "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation-runs/suite.yaml" "$T/suite.yaml"   # B's suite file as landed
31	  make_tasks
32	  make_wrappers
33	}
34	
35	teardown() {
36	  chmod -R u+rwx "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
37	  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
38	  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
39	}
40	
41	make_source_tree() {
42	  local s
43	  mkdir -p "$T/src/.claude/loa" "$T/src/.claude/scripts"
44	  for s in planning-sprints implementing-tasks reviewing-code auditing-security; do
45	    mkdir -p "$T/src/.claude/skills/$s"
46	    printf -- '---\nname: %s\neffort: xhigh\n---\nbody\n' "$s" > "$T/src/.claude/skills/$s/SKILL.md"
47	  done
48	  echo "loa" > "$T/src/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
49	  printf 'flatline_protocol:\n  enabled: true\n  code_review:\n    enabled: true\n  security_audit:\n    enabled: true\n' > "$T/src/.loa.config.yaml"
50	  ( cd "$T/src" && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -qm init )
51	  # the operator's credential directories (copied per run in container mode)
52	  mkdir -p "$T/home/.aws" "$T/home/.claude/projects/big" "$T/home/.codex/sessions"
53	  echo "[default]" > "$T/home/.aws/config"
54	  echo "{}" > "$T/home/.claude/settings.json"
55	  echo "history" > "$T/home/.claude/history.jsonl"
56	  echo "{}" > "$T/home/.codex/auth.json"
57	  echo "model = 'x'" > "$T/home/.codex/config.toml"
58	  echo '{"claudeAiOauth": "subscription"}' > "$T/home/.claude/.credentials.json"
59	}

61	# a temporary copy of the harness: the stub mount library sits at the literal path
62	# pipeline-run.sh sources (lib/sandbox-mount.sh)
63	make_harness() {
64	  H="$T/h/evals/harness"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# took-effect.sh — prove an arm's configuration took effect, from run artefacts
     4	# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)
     5	#
     6	# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
     7	# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
     8	# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
     9	# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
    10	# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
    11	#
    12	# Rules:
    13	#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
    14	#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file
    15	#   no_audit_rows              no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl (no hook ran)
    16	#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
    17	#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
    18	#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
    19	#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
    20	#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
    21	#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false
    22	#   no_gate_phases             no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record
    23	#   enforce_env_false          every captured phase env has LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
    24	#   no_flatline_rows           no eval/ MODELINV row whose calling_primitive starts with
    25	#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
    26	#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
    27	#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
    28	#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
    29	#                              each other and from every implementer session id
    30	#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium
    31	#   skill_effort_stripped      no sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter has an ^effort:
    32	#                              line (the block between the first two `---` lines; body lines
    33	#                              are not frontmatter)
    34	#   integrity_clean            arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 is present and every entry of
    35	#                              sandbox/.claude/checksums.json hashes to its recorded value
    36	#                              (Python hashlib walk); a loa_mount: false arm passes with
    37	#                              "no mount"
    38	#   applicability_refused      a refusal record (meta/refused.json) names this arm and a task
    39	#                              type outside its task_types; a run that was not refused passes
    40	#                              when its task type is inside task_types (and fails otherwise)
    41	# A refusal record is evaluated on applicability_refused alone.
    42	#
    43	# Usage:
    44	#   took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    45	#   took-effect.sh --batch-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    46	#
    47	# Output: `arm <id>: <rule> OK|FAIL <evidence>` per rule, then `arm <id>: OK` or
    48	# `arm <id>: FAIL (<n> of <m> rules)`; --batch-dir adds `took-effect: <runs> runs, <k> failed`.
    49	# --json prints one object per run ({run_dir, arm, ok, rules: [{rule, ok, evidence}]}).
    50	#
    51	# Exit codes:
    52	#   0  every rule OK
    53	#   1  any rule FAIL
    54	#   2  usage error (missing files, unknown arm)
    55	#
    56	# Tested by evals/tests/took-effect.bats (fixture runs under
    57	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    58	# =============================================================================
    59	set -euo pipefail
    60	export LC_ALL=C
    61	
    62	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
    63	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
    64	
    65	RUN_DIR="" BATCH_DIR="" SUITE_FILE="" ARM_OPT="" JSON=false
    66	usage() { echo "took-effect.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    67	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    68	  case "$1" in
    69	    --run-dir)    RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    70	    --batch-dir)  BATCH_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    71	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    72	    --arm)        ARM_OPT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    73	    --json)       JSON=true; shift ;;
    74	    -h|--help)    sed -n '2,56p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    75	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    76	  esac
    77	done
    78	[[ -n "$SUITE_FILE" && -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || usage "missing or unreadable --suite-file"
    79	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" || -n "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "one of --run-dir or --batch-dir is required"
    80	[[ -z "$RUN_DIR" || -z "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "--run-dir and --batch-dir are exclusive"
    81	SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || usage "suite file does not parse"
    82	
    83	# ---- rule helpers: each sets EVID and returns 0 (OK) / 1 (FAIL) --------------------
    84	EVID=""
    85	argv_files() { local f; for f in "$R/meta"/phase-*.argv.json; do [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$f"; done; return 0; }
    86	envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → path or empty
    87	  local f="$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
    88	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$R/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
    89	  [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s' "$f"; return 0
    90	}
    91	
    92	expected_labels() {  # the arm's phase set for this run's task type (pipeline-run.sh's plan)
    93	  local type kind
    94	  type="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
    95	  if [[ "$type" == review-catch ]]; then kind=review-catch; else kind=build; fi
    96	  jq -r -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --arg kind "$kind" \
    97	    --argjson tg "$(jq -c '.arm_toggles // {}' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" '
    98	    (if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end) as $dflt
    99	    | ($arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt) as $p0
   100	    | (if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end) as $p1
   101	    | (if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end) as $p2
   102	    | (if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end) as $p3
   103	    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
   104	        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += ["FIX" + (.fix | tostring)] else .out += [$n] end)
   105	    | .out | join(",")'
   106	}
   107	
   108	rule_no_dot_claude() {
   109	  if [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" || -e "$R/sandbox/CLAUDE.md" ]]; then EVID="sandbox has .claude/ or CLAUDE.md"; return 1; fi
   110	  EVID="sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md"
   111	}
   112	rule_no_system_prompt() {
   113	  local f n=0 hit=""
   114	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   115	    n=$((n + 1))
   116	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | index("--append-system-prompt-file") != null' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && hit="$hit $(basename "$f")"
   117	  done < <(argv_files)
   118	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
   119	  [[ -z "$hit" ]] || { EVID="--append-system-prompt-file in$hit"; return 1; }
   120	  EVID="no --append-system-prompt-file in $n argv"
   121	}
   122	rule_no_audit_rows() {
   123	  [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl" ]] && { EVID="sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl exists"; return 1; }
   124	  EVID="no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl"
   125	}
   126	rule_all_phases_present() {
   127	  local want got st
   128	  want="$(expected_labels)"
   129	  got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   130	  st="$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   131	  if [[ "$got" == "$want" ]]; then EVID="phases $got"; return 0; fi
   132	  case "$st" in
   133	    cap_failure|agent_error|interrupted|running)
   134	      if [[ -n "$got" && ",$want," == ",$got,"* ]]; then EVID="phases $got (run stopped: $st; set $want)"; return 0; fi ;;
   135	  esac
   136	  EVID="phases ${got:-none}, want $want (status $st)"; return 1
   137	}
   138	rule_no_plan_phase() {
   139	  local n; n="$(jq '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN")] | length' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   140	  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n PLAN record(s)"; return 1; }
   141	  EVID="no PLAN record"
   142	}
   143	rule_one_voice_planned() {
   144	  local g f v bad="" ev=""
   145	  for g in review audit; do
   146	    f="$(envelope "$g")"
   147	    if [[ -z "$f" ]]; then bad="$bad $g:missing"; continue; fi
   148	    v="$(jq -r 'if (.metadata.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .metadata.companion_voice.planned
   149	                elif (.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .companion_voice.planned else "absent" end | tostring' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo unreadable)"
   150	    ev="$ev $g:planned=$v"
   151	    [[ "$v" == false ]] || bad="$bad $g:planned=$v"
   152	  done
   153	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="companion_voice${bad}"; return 1; }
   154	  EVID="companion_voice${ev}"
   155	}
   156	rule_no_gate_phases() {
   157	  local got; got="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" or .name == "AUDIT" or .name == "FIX") | .label] | join(",")' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   158	  [[ -z "$got" ]] || { EVID="gate records $got"; return 1; }
   159	  EVID="no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record"
   160	}
   161	rule_enforce_env_false() {
   162	  local f n=0 bad=""
   163	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   164	    n=$((n + 1))
   165	    [[ "$(jq -r '.env.LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE // "unset"' "$f")" == false ]] || bad="$bad $(basename "$f" .argv.json)"
   166	  done < <(argv_files)
   167	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
   168	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE not false in$bad"; return 1; }
   169	  EVID="LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false in $n/$n phase env"
   170	}
   171	rule_no_flatline_rows() {
   172	  local n=0
   173	  if [[ -f "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
   174	    n="$(jq -R -n '[inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")
   175	           | (.payload.calling_primitive // .calling_primitive // .agent // "") | select(test("^flatline"))] | length' \
   176	         "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl")"
   177	  fi
   178	  [[ "$n" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$n flatline MODELINV row(s)"; return 1; }
   179	  [[ -f "$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md" ]] || { EVID="no flatline rows but no sandbox sprint.md"; return 1; }
   180	  EVID="no flatline MODELINV rows; sprint.md present"
   181	}
   182	rule_implementer_single_session() {
   183	  local ids n sid f bad=""
   184	  ids="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.skipped != true and (.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX")) | .session_id]' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   185	  n="$(jq 'length' <<<"$ids")"
   186	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no implementer record"; return 1; }
   187	  [[ "$(jq '[.[] | select(. == null)] | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="an implementer record has no session_id"; return 1; }
   188	  [[ "$(jq 'unique | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 1 ]] || { EVID="implementer session ids $(jq -r 'unique | join(",")' <<<"$ids")"; return 1; }
   189	  sid="$(jq -r '.[0]' <<<"$ids")"
   190	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   191	    case "$(jq -r '.name' "$f")" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) ;; *) continue ;; esac
   192	    jq -e '.resume == null' "$f" >/dev/null && continue
   193	    jq -e --arg s "$sid" '.resume == $s and ((.argv | index("--resume")) as $i | $i != null and .argv[$i + 1] == $s)' "$f" >/dev/null \
   194	      || bad="$bad $(jq -r '.label' "$f")"
   195	  done < <(argv_files)
   196	  [[ -z "$bad" ]] || { EVID="continuation argv does not resume $sid:$bad"; return 1; }
   197	  EVID="one session $sid across $n implementer record(s)"
   198	}
   199	rule_gates_separate_sessions() {
   200	  local r a impl
   201	  r="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   202	  a="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "AUDIT" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   203	  impl="$(jq -c '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX") | .session_id | select(. != null)] | unique' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   204	  [[ "$r" != null && "$a" != null ]] || { EVID="gate session ids review=$r audit=$a"; return 1; }
   205	  [[ "$r" != "$a" ]] || { EVID="REVIEW and AUDIT share session $r"; return 1; }
   206	  if jq -e --arg r "$r" --arg a "$a" 'index($r) != null or index($a) != null' <<<"$impl" >/dev/null; then
   207	    EVID="a gate shares an implementer session"; return 1
   208	  fi
   209	  EVID="review $r, audit $a, implementer $(jq -r 'join(",")' <<<"$impl")"
   210	}
   211	rule_effort_flag_medium() {
   212	  local f n=0 ok=0
   213	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   214	    n=$((n + 1))
   215	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | (index("--effort")) as $i | $i != null and .[$i + 1] == "medium"' "$f" >/dev/null && ok=$((ok + 1))
   216	  done < <(argv_files)
   217	  [[ $n -gt 0 && $ok -eq $n ]] || { EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"; return 1; }
   218	  EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"
   219	}
   220	rule_skill_effort_stripped() {
   221	  local f n=0 hit=0
   222	  for f in "$R"/sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
   223	    [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
   224	    n=$((n + 1))
   225	    # the YAML frontmatter only (first line `---` to the next `---`); a body line may say effort:
   226	    awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" {exit} NR > 1 && $0 == "---" {exit} NR > 1 && /^effort:/ {hit = 1; exit} END {exit !hit}' "$f" \
   227	      && hit=$((hit + 1))
   228	  done
   229	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no sandbox SKILL.md"; return 1; }
   230	  [[ $hit -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$hit/$n SKILL.md still carry effort:"; return 1; }
   231	  EVID="skill effort lines stripped $n/$n"
   232	}
   233	rule_integrity_clean() {
   234	  local man="$R/sandbox/.claude/checksums.json" msha out
   235	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.arm_toggles.loa_mount' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" == false ]]; then
   236	    [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" ]] && { EVID="loa_mount: false but sandbox has .claude/"; return 1; }
   237	    EVID="no mount (loa_mount: false)"; return 0
   238	  fi
   239	  msha="$(jq -r '.arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 // empty' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   240	  [[ -n "$msha" && "$msha" != none ]] || { EVID="no arm_evidence.manifest_sha256"; return 1; }
   241	  [[ -f "$man" ]] && jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$man" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { EVID="no sandbox .claude/checksums.json files map"; return 1; }
   242	  # one hashlib walk over every manifest entry: "<n> <tampered> <missing> <file-sha> <first problem>"
   243	  out="$(python3 -I -c '
   244	import hashlib, json, os, sys
   245	root, man = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   246	def sha(p):
   247	    h = hashlib.sha256()
   248	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
   249	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
   250	            h.update(b)
   251	    return h.hexdigest()
   252	files = json.load(open(man)).get("files") or {}
   253	bad = missing = 0; first = "-"
   254	for rel, want in sorted(files.items()):
   255	    p = os.path.join(root, rel)
   256	    if not os.path.isfile(p):
   257	        missing += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "missing " + rel
   258	    elif sha(p) != want:
   259	        bad += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "tampered " + rel
   260	print(len(files), bad, missing, sha(man), first)' "$R/sandbox" "$man")" || { EVID="hash walk failed"; return 1; }
   261	  local n bad missing filesha first
   262	  read -r n bad missing filesha first <<<"$out"
   263	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="manifest lists no files"; return 1; }
   264	  if [[ "$bad" -gt 0 || "$missing" -gt 0 ]]; then EVID="$bad tampered, $missing missing of $n ($first)"; return 1; fi
   265	  EVID="$n manifest entries verified; manifest_sha256 ${msha:0:12}"
   266	  [[ "$filesha" == "$msha" ]] && EVID="$EVID (matches checksums.json)"
   267	  return 0
   268	}
   269	rule_applicability_refused() {
   270	  local f="$R/meta/refused.json" a t
   271	  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then
   272	    # a run that was not refused: its task type must be one the arm declares
   273	    t="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   274	    local k=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && k=review-catch
   275	    if jq -e --arg k "$k" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   276	         <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   277	      EVID="applicable: $t in task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") (no refusal needed)"; return 0
   278	    fi
   279	    EVID="ran on $t outside task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") without a refusal record"; return 1
   280	  fi
   281	  a="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$f")"; t="$(jq -r '.type // ""' "$f")"
   282	  [[ "$a" == "$ARM" && -n "$t" ]] || { EVID="refusal record names arm '$a' type '$t'"; return 1; }
   283	  local kind=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && kind=review-catch
   284	  if jq -e --arg k "$kind" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   285	       <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   286	    EVID="arm task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF") include $t, yet the run was refused"; return 1
   287	  fi
   288	  EVID="refused $t (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
   289	}
   290	
   291	# ---- one run ------------------------------------------------------------------------
   292	check_run() {  # check_run <run-dir> → prints lines; returns 0/1; 2 on usage problems
   293	  R="$1"
   294	  local arm rules rule fails=0 total=0 results='[]' ok
   295	  if [[ -n "$ARM_OPT" ]]; then arm="$ARM_OPT"
   296	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/arm" ]]; then arm="$(sed -n '1p' "$R/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
   297	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/refused.json")"
   298	  else arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi
   299	  [[ -n "$arm" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no arm for $R" >&2; return 2; }
   300	  ARM="$arm"
   301	  ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$arm" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
   302	  [[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm is not declared in the suite" >&2; return 2; }
   303	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == true ]]; then
   304	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: true, absent: true, rules: []}'
   305	    else printf 'arm %s: absent (component-absent; no rules)\n' "$arm"; fi
   306	    return 0
   307	  fi
   308	  if [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then
   309	    rules="applicability_refused"
   310	  else
   311	    [[ -f "$R/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no meta/pipeline.json under $R" >&2; return 2; }
   312	    rules="$(jq -r '(.took_effect // []) | .[]' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
   313	    [[ -n "$rules" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm lists no took_effect rules" >&2; return 2; }
   314	  fi
   315	  while IFS= read -r rule; do
